Front Door Window Glass — Power Windows — Montego and Fairlane — Model 71
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove two screws attaching the regulator arm roller bracket to the door inner panel and remove the bracket.
Disconnect the motor wires at the connector.
Remove the motor bracket-to-door inner panel attaching screw (Figs. 7 and 8).
Remove the glass lower stop from the door.
Remove the nut and washer from the vent window division bar lower adjusting screw.
Remove four screws attaching the window regulator to the door inner panel. Support the glass and channel assembly and lay the regulator in the bottom of the door panel.
Remove the front run and retainer from the vent window division bar.
Remove three screws retaining the vent window assembly in the door and remove the vent window assembly from the door.
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the door.
Remove the glass from the channel with the tool shown in Fig. 17.

Installation

Install the glass in the glass channel with the tool shown in Fig. 17.
Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the door.
Position the vent window assembly to the door and install the three retaining screws (Figs. 7 and 8).
Position the front run and retainer into the door. Then, place the glass in the front and rear runs and insert the front run into the vent window division bar.
Support the glass and insert the regulator arm rollers into the glass channel bracket.
Position the window regulator to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Insert the regulator arm roller in the regulator arm roller bracket. Position the roller bracket to the door inner panel and install the two attaching screws.
Install the washer and nut on the vent window division bar lower adjusting screw (Figs. 7 and 8).
Install the motor bracket-to-door inner panel attaching screw (Figs. 7 and 8) and connect the motor wires.
Install the window glass lower stop, and adjust the door window glass.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door. Then, clean the glass and surrounding area.

Front Door Window Glass — Fairlane and Montego — Model 57
Removal

Remove the trim panel and weathersheet.
Remove the belt line dust seal at the rear of the door.
Remove the outside belt weatherstrip.
Remove the front and rear screws attaching the glass and bracket assembly to the channel bracket (Fig. 4)
Slide the glass and bracket assembly out of the door through the rear notch. Remove the glass and bracket assembly to a bench.
Remove the nuts, bolts and bushings from the glass and bracket assembly.
Remove the brackets from the glass. Remove and discard the rubber spacers from the brackets.

Installation

Position new rubber spacers on the glass. Position the brackets on the glass and install the bolts, bushings and nuts. Torque the bolts to 40-90 in-lbs. Be sure that the spacers are properly positioned flat against the glass. Wrinkled or crimped spacers can cause cracked windows.
Slide the glass assembly into position through the notch in the rear of the door.
Position the channel bracket to the glass assembly and install the front and rear glass bracket-to-channel bracket attaching screws.
Install the outside belt weatherstrip.
Install the dust seal at the rear notch of the door.
Adjust the window as required.
Install the weathersheet and trim panel.

Fairlane and Montego — Model 54
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and peel back the watershield.
Remove both rear run retainers located at the mid point of the door and at the bottom of the run.
Lower the window one third of the way down.
Remove the screws retaining the glass channel bracket (Fig. 8) to the glass channel and lower the window down in the door.
Remove the belt line weatherstrip.
Move the window down in the door, tilt it nearly 90 degrees forward and remove it up and out of the window opening while tilting it slightly inward.

Installation

Position the glass assembly in the door.
Install the belt line weatherstrip.
Position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the retaining screws.
Install the rear run retainers.
Install the window lower stop bumper.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

Front Door Window Glass — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 54, 62 and 71
Removal


Remove the door trim panel and peel back the watershield.

Fig. 18 — Front Door Glass — Bolt-On Type — Fairlane and Montego


Remove the rear run retainer.


Lower the window one third of the way down


Remove the screws retaining the glass channel bracket (Fig. 10) to the glass channel and lower the window down in the door.


Remove the belt line weatherstrip.


Move the window down in the door, tilt it nearly 90 degrees forward and remove it up and out of the window opening while tilting it slightly inward.


Remove the glass channel from the glass using a removal tool such as shown in Fig. 17.


Installation

Install the glass channel on the glass using a tool such as shown in Fig. 17.
Position the glass assembly in the door.
Install the belt line weatherstrip.
Position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the retaining screws.
Install the rear run retainer.
Install the window lower stop bumper.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

Front Door Window Ventless Glass — Fairlane and Montego — Models 63, 65, 66 and 76
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the upper front stop bracket with the stop attached from the door (Fig. 4).
Remove the upper rear stop from the door (Fig. 4).
Remove two nuts attaching each guide to the glass and channel assembly and remove the front and rear guide.
Remove two screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel (Fig. 4).
Remove the nut retaining the window regulator arm to the glass channel at the pivot (Fig. 4) and remove the pivot.
Remove five screws attaching the weatherstrip to the rear top edge of the door and two screws attaching the weatherstrip to the top front edge of the door. Position the weatherstrip ends away from the door.
Remove the glass and bracket assembly from the door. A recess is provided at the front and rear edge of the glass opening to provide clearance for the stop tabs when removing the glass and bracket assembly. To remove the glass, lift the glass straight up, allowing the tabs on the bracket to pass through the recess provided at the front and rear of the glass opening.
Place the glass and bracket assembly on a bench and remove the nuts, bolts and neoprene bushings from the glass and bracket (Fig. 18). Remove the brackets from the glass and remove the rubber spacers from the brackets and discard the spacers. Also, remove and discard the spacers from the window guides.

Installation

Position new spacers on the glass and place the brackets over the gasket. Be sure the spacers lie flat against the glass. Wrinkled or crimped spacers can cause window cracking.
Install the neoprene bushings, bolts and nuts to attach the glass to the brackets. Torque the bolts to 40-90 in-lbs. Be sure that there is no dirt or broken glass in the bracket bolt hole indentations. Particles of dirt or glass can cause uneven torque which can result in cracked glass.
Insert the glass and bracket assembly into the door.
Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the window regulator arm to the glass bracket and install the pivot and retaining nut (Fig. 4).
Position the glass channel bracket to the regulator arm roller and the glass channel. Install the two glass channel bracket attaching screws.
Install new spacers on the front and rear guides. Position the front and rear guides to the glass brackets and install the attaching nuts (Fig. 4). Torque the nuts to 40-90 in-lbs.
Install the upper front stop bracket and the upper rear stop (Fig. 4).
Adjust the window mechanism.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Window Ventless Glass — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury, Meteor, Mustang and Cougar
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the front and rear guides from the glass bracket (Figs. 2 and 3).
Remove the front stop and bracket (Figs. 2 and 3).
Remove the rear stop from the door.
Disconnect the window regulator arm from the glass channel or bracket at the pivot (Figs. 2 and 3).
Remove the drive arm bracket from the glass channel or bracket (Figs. 2 and 3).
Remove the belt weatherstrip(s) from the door.
Remove the glass and channel or bracket assembly.
If equipped with bolt-on glass, place the glass and bracket assembly on a bench and remove the nuts, bolts and neoprene bushings from the glass and bracket. Remove the brackets from the glass and remove the rubber spacers from the brackets and discard the spacers. Also, remove and discard the spacers from the window guides.

Installation

If equipped with bolt-on glass, position new spacers on the glass and place the brackets over the gasket. Be sure the spacers lie flat against the glass. Wrinkled or crimped spacers can cause window cracking.
Install the neoprene bushings, bolts and nuts to attach the glass to the brackets. Torque the bolts to 40-90 in-lbs. Be sure that there is no dirt or broken glass in the bracket bolt hole indentations. Particles of dirt or glass can cause uneven torque which can result in cracked glass.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the door.
If equipped with bolt-on glass, install new spacers on the guides. Slide the guides on the glass runs and attach the guides to the glass channel or bracket (Figs. 2 and 3). With bolt-on glass, torque the retaining nuts 40-90 in-lbs.
Install the belt weatherstrip(s).
Connect the window regulator arm to the glass channel at the pivot (Figs. 2 and 3).
Place the drive arm bracket on the regulator arm roller and attach the bracket to the glass channel.
Install and adjust the front and rear stops.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

Door Window Ventless Glass — Continental Mark III and Thunderbird
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove three screws attaching the lock pillar seal to the door at the belt line and remove the seal.
Remove two screws attaching the lower stop to the door inner panel and remove the stop.
Lower the glass and remove eight screws attaching the belt outside weatherstrip to the door, and remove the weatherstrip.
Raise the glass about half way and support it in that position.
Remove the nut from the regulator arm to glass channel pivot and remove the pivot (Figs. 5 and 6).
Remove the upper front stop bracket from the glass channel.
Remove two screws attaching the regulator arm drive bracket (Figs. 5 and 6) to the glass channel and remove the bracket.
Remove the upper rear stop upper attaching screw and loosen the lower attaching screw.
Remove two front guide attaching bolts and remove the front guide from the glass channel.
Remove two rear guide attaching bolts and remove the rear guide from the glass channel.
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the door.

Installation

Position the glass in the door and install the belt outside weatherstrip.
Raise the glass about half way and support it in that position.
Position the front and rear guides to the glass channels and install the attaching bolts (Figs. 5 and 6).
Position the regulator arm to the glass channel and install the nut (Fig. 6).
Install the upper front stop bracket on the glass channel.
Position the regulator arm drive bracket to the regulator arm roller and the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Remove the glass support and install the glass lower stop. Adjust the lower stop to contact the lower edge of the glass when the top of the glass is flush with the belt line.
Rotate the upper rear stop into position and install the one removed (upper) attaching screw. With the window in the up position, place the upper rear stop down against the glass channel and tighten the two screws K (Figs. 5 and 6). Be sure that the anti-rattle of the stop contacts the glass and channel assembly.
With the window up, position the upper front stop down against the stop bracket and tighten the two screws securely.
Position the lock pillar seal to the door and install the three attaching screws.
With the window in the up position, move the glass and channel fore or aft as required for alignment with the body. Then, tighten the nut T (Figs. 5 and 6) securely.
Position the front and rear runs inboard or outboard as required to properly position the glass to the belt outside weatherstrip. Then, tighten the run attaching screws and check the operation of the window. If high operating efforts are encountered, refer to step 1 of the Door Window Glass Adjustment.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

Front Door Window Glass — Maverick
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and weathersheet from the door.
Remove the bolts retaining the regulator assembly and lower the regulator assembly and glass assembly to the bottom of the door.
Disconnect the regulator arms from the channel and remove the glass and channel from the door.
Place the glass and channel on a bench and remove the nylon retainers (Fig. 19) which attach the glass to the channel and remove the glass.
Position the glass to the channel and install the nylon retainers.
Insert the glass and channel assembly into the door and connect the regulator arms rollers to the channel (Fig. 19).
Raise the regulator and glass assembly into position and install the regulator retaining bolts.
Adjust the window as required.
Install the weathersheet and door trim panel.

Rear Door Window Glass — Ford, Mercury and Meteor — Models 54 and 71
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the lower window stop.
Remove the screws retaining the glass channel bracket to the glass channel.
Tilt the forward edge of the glass assembly up and remove the glass assembly from the door.
Using a tool such as shown in Fig. 17, remove the channel assembly from the glass.

Installation

Apply the new glass tape to the lower edge of the glass.
Install the glass into the channel, using a tool such as shown in Fig. 17.
Position the glass and channel assembly into the door.
Position the channel bracket to the glass channel and install the channel-bracket-to-channel retaining screws.
Install and adjust the lower glass stop.
Install the door watershield and trim panel.

Rear Door Window Glass — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 53 and 57
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the upper rear stop from the door (Fig. 12).
Remove the nut and bushing from the regulator arm to glass channel pivot (Fig. 12).
Remove the glass channel bracket from the glass channel.
Remove the rear dust cover.
Lower the glass and channel assembly and remove the belt outside weatherstrip.
Remove the front and rear guides from the glass channel and remove the glass and channel assembly from the door.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the glass in the door and to the front and rear guides. Install the front and rear guide attaching screws.
Install the belt outside weatherstrip.
Position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and window regulator arm roller and install the two attaching screws (Fig. 12).
Position the regulator arm to the glass channel pivot and install the bushing and retaining nut.
Install the glass upper rear stop (Fig. 12) and replace the dust cover.
Adjust the window mechanism.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Rear Door Window Glass — Falcon Models 54 and 71
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the two screws retaining the regulator roller channel bracket to the lower window channel (Fig. 11).
Remove the lower stop assembly.
Remove the screw and nut retaining the rear run retainer and stationary glass. Move the run retainer and glass back and down in the door.
Remove the door belt, outside weatherstrip.
Tilt the door window down and then lift it out of the door.
Using a tool such as shown in Fig. 17, remove the glass from the lower channel.

Installation

Position new glass tape on the glass and, using a tool such as shown in Fig. 17, install the lower channel on the glass.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the door.
Position the rear run retainer and stationary glass assembly and install the retainer screw and nut.
Install the regulator roller channel bracket on the window channel.
Install the lower window stop.
Install the door trim watershield and the door trim panel.
Install the window outside belt weatherstrip.

Rear Door Window Glass — Fairlane and Montego Model 54
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Support the glass and channel assembly. Remove three glass channel bracket attaching screws and separate the bracket from the glass channel.
Remove two screws attaching the glass channel to the front and rear roller carriers (Fig. 20) and lower the glass to the bottom of the door.
Remove the belt weatherstrips from the door.
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the door.

Installation

Lubricate the glass mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the door.
Install the belt weatherstrip in the door.
Position the front and rear roller carriers to the glass channel and install the two attaching screws (Fig. 20)
Position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the three attaching screws.
Check the operation of the window mechanism and install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Rear Door Window Glass — Fairlane and Montego — Model 57
Removal


Remove the trim panel and weathersheet.


Remove the front and rear dust seal from the upper side of the door.


Remove the upper rear stop from the door.


Remove the screws retaining the rear channel bracket to the glass and channel assembly and remove the bracket (Fig. 21).


Remove the two bolts retaining the front guide to the glass channel.


Remove the screws retaining the rear guide and bracket assembly and remove the guide assembly.


Remove the glass and channel assembly from the door.


Using a block of wood and a hammer, pound the vertical weatherstrip retainer and weatherstrip off the front edge of the glass.

Fig. 19 — Door Window Glass — Maverick

Fig. 20 — Rear Door Window Mechanism — Fairlane and Montego — Model 54


Installation

Using everseal bonding tape, install the weatherstrip and retainer on the front edge of the glass. Be sure the top end of the retainer is at least 1/4 inch below the top edge of the glass.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the door. Position the regulator arm to the front channel bracket.
Position the rear guide and bracket in the door and install the retaining screws.
Position the rear channel bracket on the glass and channel assembly and install the retaining screws.
Position the front guide to the glass channel assembly and install the retaining bolts.
Install the upper rear stop on the channel assembly.
Install the front and rear dust covers
Adjust the window as required.
Install the weathersheet and trim panel.

Rear Door Window Glass — Power Windows — Fairlane and Montego Model 71
Removal


Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.


Remove one screw attaching the division bar to the division bar lower bracket (Fig. 22).


Remove one screw attaching the division bar lower bracket to the door inner panel and remove the bracket.


Remove the division bar upper attaching screw (Fig. 22).


Lower the window glass and remove the division bar and rear run assembly from the door.


Remove the stationary window glass and weatherstrip from the door.


Remove two screws attaching the roller front carrier to the glass channel (Fig. 22).


Raise the window glass and support in the raised position.


Remove three screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel. Remove the window glass and channel assembly from the door.


Remove the glass channel from the window glass with the tool shown in Fig. 17.


Fig. 22 — Rear Door Window Mechanism — Fairlane and Montego — Model 71


Installation

Install the glass channel on the window glass with the tool shown in Fig. 17.
Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the door and to the glass channel bracket (Fig. 22).
Install three screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel.
Align the roller front carrier with the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Lubricate the stationary window glass weatherstrip with Silicone lubricant (COAZ-19553-A or C). Then, position the window glass and weatherstrip in the door.
Position the division bar and rear run assembly in the door and install the division bar upper attaching screw.
Position the division bar lower bracket to the division bar and door inner panel. Then, install the two attaching screws.
Adjust the window mechanism.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Rear Door Window Glass — Thunderbird
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove two bolts attaching the front guide (Fig. 13) to the glass channel and remove the guide from the door.
Remove two screws attaching the regulator arm bracket to the glass channel and remove the bracket.
Remove the nut and washer from the regulator arm to glass channel pivot, and remove the pivot, bushing, and washer (Fig. 13).
Remove four screws retaining the rear weatherstrip to the top of the door and remove the weatherstrip.
Remove the glass and channel from the door.

Installation

Position the glass and glass channel in the door.
Position the regulator arm bracket to the regulator arm and the glass channel and install the two attaching screws (Fig. 13).
Position the regulator arm to the glass channel and install the pivot, bushing, washers and nuts (Fig. 13).
Position the front guide to the front run and glass channel and install the two attaching bolts.
Adjust the glass as outlined in Section I and install the rear weatherstrip on top of the door.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Rear Door Stationary Window Glass and/or Weatherstrip — Fairlane and Montego Model 71
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the bumper from the glass lower stop.
Remove two screws attaching the roller carrier to the glass channel (Fig. 22). Lower the glass and channel assembly to the bottom of the door.
Remove the division bar lower bracket attaching screw (bolt on the Falcon).
Remove the division bar upper attaching screw (Fig. 22).
Pull the upper run out of the retainer and away from the division
Remove the glass run retainer and division bar from the door.
Pull the stationary glass and weatherstrip from the door.
Remove the weatherstrip from the glass. Clean the glass and/or weatherstrip if either is to be reused.

Installation

Apply sealer (C5AZ-19554-A) to the glass opening groove of the weatherstrip.
Apply sealer (C5AZ-19554-A) to the division bar in the area of the area of the stationary glass weatherstrip.
Position the glass and weatherstrip in the door.
Position the division bar in the door and to the stationary window weatherstrip.
Install the division bar upper attaching screw.
Raise the glass and position the roller carrier to the glass channel. Install the two roller carrier attaching screws.
Install the division bar lower bracket attaching screw snug. Adjust the window mechanism.
Install the lower stop bumper.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Power Window By-Pass Switch Elimination -- Lincoln Continental, Continental Mark III and Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-02
Disconnect the battery ground cable and remove the access cover from the left front door armrest. Locate the black-white stripe wire connected to the lock-out and by-pass switch connector. Cut the black-white stripe wire 3 inches from the connector and tape the ends of both wires to prevent the wire ends of the wires from shorting to the body.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Power Window By-Pass Switch Elimination -- Ford, Mercury and Meteor
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-02a
Disconnect the battery ground cable. Locate the connection of the 14631 wire harness and the 14A200 wire harness under the left side of the instrument panel near the cowl side panel (Fig. 1). Disconnect the black-white stripe wire from the connector and insert the male connector into the female connector (Fig. 1) to prevent the wire from shorting to the body. Station Wagon only: Connect the wire from the rear window to the 14A200 wire harness as shown in Fig. 1.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Removal and Installation
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-04
Power Window Relay — Falcon, Fairlane, and Montego
Removal

Disconnect the ground cable from the battery.
Remove two screws attaching the relay to the right side of the dash panel in the engine compartment.
Disconnect the wires from the relay and remove the relay.

Installation

Connect the wires to the relay.
Position the relay to the dash panel and install the two attaching screws.
Connect the battery ground cable, and check the operation of the power window(s).

Power Window Switch — Ford, Mercury and Meteor
Locate the notch at each end of the switch bezel. Insert a small screwdriver in the notch and depress the bezel locking tab until the bezel is released. Then, release the other end of the bezel using the same procedure. To remove the switch, carefully pry the switch out of the retainer with a small screwdriver.
Power Window Switch — Fairlane, Montego and Cougar

Remove the trim panel.
Disconnect the wire connector from the window switch.
Remove the switch attaching screws and remove the switch from the trim panel.
Position the switch and retainer to the trim panel and install the attaching screws.
Connect the wire connector to the window switch and install the trim panel.

Power Window Switch — Thunderbird, Continental Mark III and Lincoln Continental

Remove the armrest (Group 47).
From the bottom side of the armrest, remove the switch retaining screws, disconnect the switch and remove it from the armrest.
Fasten the switch into position with the retaining screws and connect the multiple connector.
Install the armrest.

Power Window Relay — Ford, Mercury and Meteor

Disconnect the battery and locate the relay in the engine compartment on the dash panel.
Disconnect the connectors from the relay and remove the retaining screws. Remove the relay.
Install the relay to the dash panel and connect the push-on connectors.
Connect the battery.

Power Window Relay — Lincoln Continental

Locate the relay in the luggage compartment on the package tray.
Disconnect the multiple connector and remove the relay retaining screws. Remove the relay.
Install the relay to the package tray and connect the multiple connector.

Power Window Relay — Cougar
Removal

Disconnect the battery.
In the engine compartment, on the right wheel well disconnect the two plug-on connectors.
Loosen the screw holding the remaining connector and disconnect the wire.
Remove the relay retaining screws and remove the relay.

Installation

Position the relay to the wheel well and install the retaining screws.
Push the snap-on connectors in place and tighten the remaining connector with the retaining screw.
Connect the battery.

Power Window Relay — Thunderbird and Continental Mark III

Disconnect the battery.
Locate the relay in the engine compartment on the dash panel. Disconnect the multiple connector and remove the screw retaining the wires to the dash panel.
Remove the relay retaining screws and remove the relay.
Install the relay to the dash panel.
Fasten the wires with the retaining screw to the dash panel. Then, connect the multiple connector.
Connect the battery.

Power Window and/or Door Lock Switch — Thunderbird
Removal

Remove the armrest finish panel attaching screws and remove the finish panel.
Remove the speaker from the armrest, if so equipped.
Remove the bezel and nut from the mirror remote control (left front door only).
Remove six screws attaching the armrest to the door.
Pull the armrest away from the trim panel. Disconnect the power window switch wires and vacuum switch hoses, and feed the mirror control cable out of the armrest, if so equipped.
Remove two screws and remove the switch from the armrest.

Installation

Position the switch to the armrest and install the two attaching screws.
Position the armrest to the door and route the mirror control through the hole in the armrest. Then, install the bezel and nut.
Connect the vacuum hoses to the door lock switch and the wires to the power window switch.
Install the six armrest attaching screws.
Install the speaker in the armrest and install the armrest finish panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Window Regulator -- Manual Windows -- Montego, Falcon, Fairlane -- Models 54 and 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-04a
Refer to Fig. 7, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Prop the window in the up position.
Remove four window regulator attaching screws and remove the regulator from the door.

Installation

Lubricate the window regulator roller and glass channel bracket (Section 1).
Position the window regulator in the door and insert the window regulator roller in the glass channel bracket.
Position the regulator to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Window Regulator and/or Motor -- Montego and Fairlane -- Models 54 and 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-04b
Refer to Fig. 7, Part 42-02

Fig. 1 — Power Window By-Pass Switch Elimination — Ford, Mercury and Meteor

Fig. 2 — Motor and Drive Assembly Removal Precaution
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove two screws attaching the regulator arm roller bracket to the door inner panel and remove the bracket.
Disconnect the motor wires at the connector.
Remove the motor bracket-to-door inner panel attaching screw.
Remove the nut and washer from the vent window division bar lower adjusting screw.
Remove four screws attaching the window regulator to the door inner panel. Support the glass and channel assembly and disengage the regulator arm roller from the glass channel. Then, lay the window regulator in the bottom of the door panel.
Remove the lower stop from the door inner panel.
Lower the glass and pull the front run and retainer out of the vent window division bar.
Remove the window regulator assembly from the door.
If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 2). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.
Lubricate the glass mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the motor and transmission to the regulator and install the three attaching screws.
Position the regulator assembly in the door.
Insert the front run and retainer into the vent window division bar.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the front and rear runs. Raise the glass and support in the up position. Install the washer and nut on the vent window division bar lower adjusting screw.
Insert the regulator arm roller in the glass channel bracket. Then, position the regulator assembly to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Position the regulator arm roller bracket to the regulator arm roller and the door inner panel and install the two attaching screws.
Position the motor bracket to the door inner panel and install the attaching screw.
Adjust the door window as outlined in Part 42-02 and install the lower stop.
Connect the motor wires at the connector and check the operation of the window mechanism.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Window Regulator — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 54, 62 and 71
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the screws retaining the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and prop the window in its up position.
Disconnect the motor bracket and wires if equipped with an electric window regulator.
Remove the equalizer bracket from the door.
Remove the four regulator attaching bolts and remove the regulator
If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator plate (Fig. 2). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation

Position the regulator assembly in the door. Engage the regulator equalizer arm in the equalizer arm bracket and install the four retaining bolts.
Remove the prop used to hold the window in its up position. Position the glass channel bracket on the regulator arms and install the screws retaining the glass channel bracket to the glass channel.
Connect the motor wires and install the motor bracket if equipped with electric windows.
Install the watershield and trim panel.

Front Door Window Regulator — Falcon Model 62
Refer to Fig. 9, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and position the watershield away from the access holes.
Disconnect the regulator from the glass channel roller.
Raise the glass by hand and secure it in the raised position.
Remove the regulator retaining bolts, and remove the regulator through the door access hole.

Installation

Position the regulator inside the door and install the retaining bolts snugly.
Lower the glass and connect the regulator.
Check the operation of the glass, adjust it if necessary, and tighten the retaining bolts.
Carefully position the watershield to the inner panel and install the trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Ventless Window Regulator -- Manual Windows -- Montego and Fairlane
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-04c
Refer to Fig. 3, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Support the glass and remove the regulator arm pivot bolt and nut.
Remove two screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and remove the bracket.
Remove the window regulator equalizer arm retaining nut.
Remove four screws attaching the regulator to the door inner panel and remove the regulator from the door.

Installation

Lubricate the glass mechanism as outlined in Part 42-01.
Position the window regulator in the door and install the four attaching screws
Insert the regulator arm roller in the glass channel bracket. Then, position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Install the regulator arm pivot bolt and nut.
Position the window regulator equalizer arm to the door inner panel and install the retaining nut.
Adjust the window mechanism (Part 42-02), if required.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Window Regulator and/or Motor -- Montego and Fairlane -- Models 63, 65, 66 and 76
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-04d
Refer to Fig. 3, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and weathersheet.
Remove the two nuts retaining the regulator channel bracket to the glass bracket. Remove the bracket from the regulator arm rollers.
Remove the nut retaining the regulator arm to the pivot stud.
Remove the bolt retaining the regulator arm to the door inner panel.
Move the glass to the full up position and support the glass.
Remove the four bolts retaining the regulator assembly to the door inner panel. Remove the bolt retaining the motor mounting bracket to the door inner panel. Disconnect the motor wires.
Remove the regulator and motor assembly out through the access hole in the door inner panel.
Install the regulator assembly in a vise and remove the motor assembly. If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 2). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.
Position the regulator and motor assembly in the door and install the four retaining bolts. If equipped with power windows, install the motor mounting bracket to the door inner panel and connect the motor wires.
Install the regulator arm attaching bolt to the door inner panel.
Position the regulator arm to the pivot stud and install the nut and washer.
Position the regulator channel bracket and install the retaining nuts.
Adjust the window as required.
Install the weathersheet and trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Window Manual Regulator -- Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-04e
Refer to Fig. 5, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Support the glass about half way down. Then, remove two screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and remove the bracket.
Remove the nut, washer, screw and bushing attaching the regulator arm pivot to the door inner panel.
Remove the nut and washer from the regulator arm to glass channel pivot and remove the pivot, bushing and washer.
Raise the glass all the way up and support it in that position.
Remove four screws attaching the armrest bracket to the door inner panel and remove the bracket.
Remove four screws attaching the regulator to the door inner panel and remove the regulator from the door.

Installation

Position the regulator to the door inner panel and install and tighten the four attaching screws.
Install the armrest bracket to the door inner panel.
Lower the glass about half way down and support it in that position.
Position the regulator arm to the glass channel and install the pivot, bushing, washers and nut.
Position the glass channel bracket to the regulator arm and the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Remove the glass support and position the regulator arm pivot to the door inner panel. Then, install the screw, bushing, washer and nut to attach the pivot to the door panel.
Raise the window to the up position and move the window glass fore or aft as required and tighten the pivot nut securely.
Check the operation of the window and install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Window Regulator and/or Motor -- Thunderbird and Continental Mark III
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-04f
Refer to Figs. 5 and 6, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door (Group 47).
Support the glass about half way down. Then, remove two screws attaching the regulator arm drive bracket to the glass channel and remove the bracket.
Remove the nut and washer from the regulator arm to glass channel pivot and remove the pivot.
Raise the glass all the way up and support it in that position.
Disconnect the regulator arm pivot from the door inner panel.
Remove four screws attaching the regulator to the door inner panel.
Remove the screw, retainer, and washer attaching the motor bracket to the door inner panel.
Disconnect the door latch remote control link from the remote control. Then, remove one screw attaching the link retaining clip to the door inner panel and allow the rod to hang from the latch.
Disconnect the motor wires at the connector and remove the window regulator and motor from the door.
Place the window regulator in a vise and remove the motor and transmission assembly from the regulator.
Position the motor and transmission assembly to the window regulator and install the three attaching screws.
Position the regulator to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Position the motor bracket to the door inner panel and install the attaching screw, washer, and retainer. Then, tighten the regulator and motor bracket attaching screws.
Connect the link to the door latch remote control. Then, install the link retaining clip.
Lower the glass about half way and support it in that position.
Position the regulator arm to the glass channel, and install the pivot.
Position the regulator arm drive bracket to the regulator arm and the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Remove the glass support and position the regulator arm pivot to the door inner panel. Then, install the nut to attach the pivot to the door panel.
Raise the window to the up position and move the window glass fore or aft as required and tighten the pivot nut securely.
Connect the motor wires at the connector and check the operation of the window. Then, install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Glass Regulator — Maverick
To remove the regulator, first remove the door trim panel and weathersheet. Then, remove the bolts retaining the regulator. Separate the regulator arms from the glass channel. Support the glass and lower the regulator to the bottom of the door and remove the regulator out through the lower access hole.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Door Window Regulator and/or Motor -- Ventless Glass -- Ford, Mercury, Meteor, Mustang and Cougar
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-05
Refer to Figs. 1 and 2, Part 42-02
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield. Remove the regulator motor bracket and disconnect the wires, if equipped with power windows.
Disconnect the window regulator arms from the glass channel and door inner panel at the pivots.
Disconnect the glass channel bracket from the glass channel.
Disconnect the remote control rod from the door latch.
Remove the rear weatherstrip cap.
Remove the upper rear stop and remove the belt weatherstrip and moulding from the door.
Remove the window regulator attaching screws and remove the regulator from the door.
If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 2). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation

Install the window regulator in the door.
Install the belt weatherstrip and moulding.
Connect the window regulator to the door at the pivots.
Place the glass channel bracket on the regulator arm roller and attach the bracket to the glass channel.
Install the rear upper stop.
Connect the remote control rod to the door latch. Install the motor bracket and connect the motor wires if equipped with electric windows.
Install the rear weatherstrip cap, align the glass, and adjust the stops and guides.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Glass Front Run -- Fairlane, Falcon and Montego -- Models 54, 62 and 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-06

Lower the window to the full down position.
Pull the front run from the retainer and vent window division bar.
Apply Silicone lubricant (COAZ-19553-A or C) to the portion of the front run that will be inserted below the belt line
Position the front run in the retainer and slide the run into the retainer. It may be necessary to raise and lower the window to assist in inserting the run. A tab is located at the lower end of the retainer and is the lower stop for the run.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Glass Front Run -- Fairlane and Montego -- Models 63, 65, 66 and 76
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-06a
Refer to Fig. 3, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove two screws attaching the front guide to the glass channel and remove the guide.
Lower the glass and remove the front run upper two attaching screws.
Raise the glass and remove the front run lower attaching screw.
Remove the front run and retainer from the door.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-01.
Position the front run and the retainer in the door and install the lower attaching screw.
Lower the glass and install the front run upper two attaching screws.
Position the front guide to the front run and the glass channel. Install the front guide two attaching screws.
Adjust the front run as outlined in Part 42-02.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Glass Run -- Ventless Glass -- Ford, Mercury, Meteor, Mustang and Cougar
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-06b
Refer to Figs. 1 and 2, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield
Remove the guide from the glass channel.
Remove the lower stop bumper and lower the glass.
Remove the glass run upper attaching screw.
Raise the glass and remove the glass run lower attaching screw. Then, disengage the run from the guide and remove the glass run.

Installation

Lubricate the glass run with Polyethylene grease (C4AZ-19584-A).
Install the run in the door and engage the run in the guide.
Install the glass run upper and lower attaching screws.
Install the lower stop bumper and adjust the glass run.
Position the guide on the glass run and to the glass channel. Install the guide attaching screw.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Glass Rear Run -- Ford, Mercury and Meteor -- Models 54, 62 and 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-06c

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the rear run retainer, lower the glass and remove the run.
Position the rear run in the upper door frame.
Install the run retainer bolt.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Glass Rear Run -- Fairlane, Falcon and Montego -- Models 54, 62 and 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-06d

Lower the window and pull the rear run and rear run retainer from the door.
Apply Silicon Lube to the new run in the area that is below the belt line.
Slide the run into the run retainer below the belt line.
Apply adhesive to the run retainer above the belt line and insert the run into the retainer. Then, raise the window to firmly seat the run in the retainer.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Ventless Glass Rear Run -- Fairlane and Montego
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-06e
Refer to Fig. 3, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the upper front stop bracket and upper rear stop from the door.
Remove the front and rear guides from the glass channel.
Remove the two glass channel bracket attaching screws.
Remove the regulator arm to pivot retaining nut and disengage the regulator arm from the pivot. Remove the pivot from the glass channel.
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the door. A recess is provided at the front and rear edge of the door inner panel to provide clearance for the stop tabs on the glass channel. To remove the glass, lift the glass straight up, allowing the tabs on the glass channel to pass through the recess provided in the door inner panel.
Remove the rear run two upper and one lower attaching screws and remove the rear run and the retainer from the door.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-01.
Position the rear run and the retainer in the door and install the three attaching screws.
Insert the glass and channel assembly in the door.
Position the window regulator arm to the glass channel, and install the pivot and retaining nut.
Position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Position the front and rear guides to the glass channel and install the attaching screws.
Install the upper front stop bracket and upper rear stop.
Adjust the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-02.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Window Glass Run -- Thunderbird and Continental Mark III
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-06f
Refer to Figs. 5 and 6, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Lower the window glass to gain access to the guide and remove the two guide attaching screws. Then, remove the guide from the door.
Remove two screws attaching the run retainer to the bottom of the door and two screws attaching the run to the door at the belt line.
Remove two screws attaching the upper front stop to the door inner panel and remove the stop.
Tilt the window glass run and remove it from the door.

Installation


Position the run in the door and install the upper and lower attaching screws.


Lubricate the run with Lubricant C4AZ-19584-B as shown in Part 42-01.


Position the guide to the run and glass channel and install the two attaching screws.


With the window in the up position, loosen the run upper attaching screws and move the top of the run inboard or outboard to properly position the window glass to the door outside belt weatherstrip. Then, tighten the two attaching screws P.


Position the upper front stop to the door inner panel and install the two attaching screws. Then, with the window all the way up, position the stop down against the stop bracket and tighten the two stop attaching screws.


With the glass in the up position, tilt the glass inboard or outboard to achieve proper engagement of the glass with the roof rail weatherstrip and a flush fit with the quarter window. This will move the run to the correct position. Then, tighten the run lower attaching screws at the bottom of the door.


Raise and lower the window to be sure the window is free of binds which could result in high operating efforts. If any binding is detected, lower the window and loosen the front run retainer attaching screws to correct any misalignment of the front run with the rear run. Then, tighten the retainer attaching screws.


Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.
FRONT DOOR VENTLESS WINDOW GLASS GUIDE (FRONT OR REAR) — FORD, MERCURY, METEOR, MUSTANG, COUGAR, FAIRLANE AND MONTEGO
Refer to Figs. 1 and 2, Part 42-02.


Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.


Remove two screws attaching the guide to the glass channel.


Disengage the guide from the run and remove the guide.


Position the guide to the run and glass channel, and install the two attaching screws.


Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.


Front Door Window Glass Guide — Thunderbird and Continental Mark III
Refer to Figs. 5 and 6, Part 42-02.

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Lower the window glass to gain access to the guide and remove the two screws attaching the guide to the glass channel.
Slide the guide off the run and remove it from the door.
Position the guide to the run and glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Check the operation of the window and install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Glass Rear Weatherstrip -- Continental Mark III and Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-07

Remove the upper weatherstrip cap at the rear of the door.
Remove the weatherstrip attaching screw and slide the weatherstrip up and off of the glass channel.
Position the new weatherstrip onto the top edge of the door weatherstrip retainer and pull it into position. Install the retaining screw.
Install the door rear weatherstrip cap.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Front Door Glass Rear Weatherstrip -- Fairlane and Montego Models 63, 65 and 76
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Front Door Glass Mechanism · 42-03-07a

Remove five screws attaching the weatherstrip to the rear top edge of the door. Position the weatherstrip end away from the door.
Remove one screw attaching the weatherstrip to the bottom of the glass channel and slide the weatherstrip up and out of the retainer.
Insert the weatherstrip in the retainer and install the retaining screw.
Position the weatherstrip end to the door and install the five attaching screws

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator -- Falcon
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03
Refer to Fig. 11, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Support the window glass and channel assembly in the up position.
Remove four screws attaching the window regulator to the door inner panel.
Disengage the regulator arm roller from the glass channel bracket and remove the regulator from the door.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-01.
Position the regulator in the door panel and insert the regulator arm roller in the glass channel bracket.
Position the regulator assembly to the door inner panel and install the attaching screws.
Remove the glass support and install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator -- Fairlane and Montego Model 54
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03a
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the equalizer arm bracket from the door inner panel.
Support the glass and channel assembly and remove the three glass channel bracket attaching screws. Separate the glass channel bracket from the regulator arm rollers.
Remove four window regulator attaching screws and remove the regulator from the door.

Installation

Position the window regulator in the door and engage the regulator arm rollers in the glass channel bracket.
Position the window regulator to the door inner panel and install the attaching screws.
Insert the regulator arm roller in the equalizer arm bracket. Position the bracket to the inner panel and install the two attaching screws.
Position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the three attaching screws.
Remove the window support and check the operation of the window mechanism.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator and/or Motor -- Fairlane and Montego Model 54
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03b
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Disconnect the motor wires at the connector.
Remove the equalizer arm bracket from the door inner panel.
Support the glass and channel assembly and remove the three glass channel bracket attaching screws. Separate the glass channel bracket from the regulator arm rollers.
Remove the screw attaching the motor bracket to the door inner panel.
Remove four window regulator attaching screws and remove the regulator from the door.
Remove the motor from the regulator. If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 1). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation

Install the motor on the window regulator.
Position the window regulator in the door and engage the regulator arm rollers in the glass channel bracket
Position the window regulator to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Install the motor bracket to door inner panel attaching screw.
Insert the regulator arm roller in the equalizer arm bracket. Position the bracket to the inner panel and install the two attaching screws.
Position the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the three attaching screws.
Connect the motor wires at the connector.
Remove the window support and check the operation of the window mechanism.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator -- Fairlane and Montego -- Model 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03c

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove four window regulator attaching screws and support the glass and channel assembly.
Disengage the regulator arm rollers from the glass channel bracket and equalizer arm bracket (Fig. 30). Remove the window regulator from the door.
Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the window regulator in the door and engage the regulator arm rollers in the glass channel bracket and equalizer arm Bracket.
Position the regulator to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Check the operation of the window mechanism. Then, install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator and/or Motor -- Fairlane and Montego -- Model 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03d
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Lower the glass.
Remove one screw attaching the division bar lower bracket.
Remove one screw attaching the division bar lower bracket to the door inner panel and remove the bracket.
Remove the division bar upper attaching screw.
Remove the division bar and rear run assembly from the door.
Remove the stationary window glass and weatherstrip from the door.
Remove four screws attaching the window regulator to the door inner panel.
Remove two screws attaching the window regulator equalizer arm bracket to the door inner panel.
Remove two screws attaching the roller front carrier to the glass channel.
Remove three screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel bracket to the glass channel. Then, remove the window glass and channel assembly from the door. Remove the window regulator and motor assembly from the door.
Remove the motor and drive assembly from the window regulator.
If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 1). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation


Assemble the motor and drive assembly to the window regulator.


Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.


Position the window regulator and drive assembly in the door and install the four attaching screws.


Position the glass channel bracket on the regulator arm rollers.


Position the window glass and channel assembly in the door and to the glass channel bracket.


Install three screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel.


Align the roller front carrier with the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.

Fig. 1 — Motor and Drive Assembly Removal Precaution


Lubricate the stationary window glass weatherstrip with Silicone lubricant (COAZ-19553-A or C). Then, position the window glass and weatherstrip in the door.


Position the division bar and rear run assembly in the door and install the division bar upper attaching screw.


Position the division bar lower bracket to the division bar and door inner panel. Then, install the two attaching screws.


Adjust the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-02.


Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Glass Run (Front or Rear) -- Ford, Mercury and Meteor -- Models 54 and 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03e

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the run from the door.
Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Install the run to the run retainer.
Install the watershield and trim panel to the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Glass Guide (Front or Rear) -- Ford, Mercury and Meteor -- Models 53 and 57
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03f
Refer to Fig. 12, Part 42-02.

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the bolts retaining the guide to the glass channel bracket. Remove the guide.
Position the guide in the door and install the retaining bolts.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Glass Run (Front or Rear) -- Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor -- Models 53 and 57
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03g
Refer to Fig. 12, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the front and rear guides from the glass channel bracket assemblies.
Remove the window regulator arm from the channel bracket assembly.
Remove the window regulator pivot stud nut, separate the arms and remove the pivot stud assembly.
Remove the rear dust cover and upper rear stop from the door.
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the door. Then, remove the run retaining bolts and remove the run from the door.

Installation

Position the run to the door and install the retaining bolts.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the door. Then, position the window regulator arms, pivot stud assembly and channel brackets. Install the retaining nut and screws. Do not tighten the pivot stud nut.
Install the front and rear guides. Loosely fasten the upper rear stop in place.
Adjust the glass as required. Then tighten the pivot stud nut and retaining screws.
Install the dust cover, watershield and trim panel to the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator -- Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 53 and 57
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03h
Removal

Remove the rear door trim panel and watershield.
Support the glass and remove the glass channel bracket from the glass channel.
Remove the nut and bushing from the glass channel pivot.
Remove the screw attaching the window regulator equalizer arm to the door inner panel.
Disconnect the window regulator motor wires and motor bracket if equipped with an electric window regulator.
Remove four regulator attaching screws and remove the regulator from the door.
If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 1). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation

Position the window regulator to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Install the motor bracket attaching screw and connect the motor wires if equipped with an electric window regulator.
Connect the window regulator equalizer arm to the door inner panel.
Position the regulator arm to the glass channel pivot and install the bushing and nut.
Position the glass channel bracket to the regulator arm roller and the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Adjust the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-02.
Install the rear door watershield and trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator -- Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 54 and 71
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03i
Refer to Fig. 15, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Support the glass and channel assembly.
Remove two screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel.
Disconnect the motor bracket and wires if equipped with electric windows.
Remove four screws attaching the window regulator to the door inner panel. Separate the window regulator arm rollers from the equalizer arm brackets and remove the regulator from the door.
Lubricate the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-01.
Position the window regulator in the door and to the equalizer arm brackets. Then, install the four window regulator attaching screws.
Position the glass channel bracket to the regulator arm rollers and the glass channel. Then, install the two attaching screws.
Install the motor bracket and connect the motor wires if equipped with electric windows.
Remove the window glass support and check the operation of the window.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Window Regulator -- Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03j
Refer to Fig. 13, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the rear door trim panel and watershield.
Lower the glass and support it 3/4 of the way down.
Remove two regulator arm brackets to glass channel attaching screws and remove the bracket.
Remove the nut and washer from the regulator arm to glass channel pivot, and remove the pivot, bushing, and washer.
Remove the nut, washer, screw and bushing attaching the regulator arm pivot to the door inner panel.
Raise the glass all the way up and support it in that position.
Remove four screws attaching the regulator to the door inner panel and remove the regulator from the door.
If equipped with power windows, drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 1). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut through the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation

Position the regulator to the door inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Lower the glass 3/4 of the way down and support it in that position.
Position the regulator arm bracket to the regulator arm and the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Position the regulator arm to the glass channel and install the pivot, bushing, washers and nuts.
Remove the glass support and position the regulator arm pivot to the door inner panel. Then, install the screw, bushing, washer and nut to attach the regulator equalizer arm to the door inner panel.
Raise the window to the up position and move the glass fore or aft as required and tighten the pivot nut securely.
Check the operation of the window and install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Glass Front Guide -- Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03k

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove two screws attaching the front guide to the glass channel and remove the guide from the door.
Position the guide to the front run and glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Adjust the guide as outlined in Part 42-02 and tighten the attaching bolts.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Glass Front Run -- Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03l
Refer to Fig. 13, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove two seal attaching screws and remove the front run seal from the bottom of the door.
Remove two screws attaching the run retainer to the bottom of the door.
Remove two run attaching screws from the top of the door.
Remove the two front guide attaching screws and remove the front guide from the door.
Tilt the run in the door and separate the run from the lower retainer. Then, remove the run from the door.

Installation

Place the front run in the door and position the run to the lower retainer.
Position the front guide to the front run and glass channel. Then, install the two guide to glass channel attaching screws.
Install the two run upper and lower attaching screws.
Cycle the glass and adjust the run as outlined in Part 42-02. Then, tighten all attaching screws.
Install the seal on the bottom of the door.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Rear Door Glass Rear Run -- Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Rear Door Glass Mechanism · 42-04-03m

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove two screws retaining the rear run to the door and remove the run from the door.
Position the run in the door and install the two attaching screws snug.
Lower the window and tighten the two run attaching screws.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.
