body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Adjustments
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-04
Quarter Window Glass Adjustment — Falcon Model 62

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
To obtain proper clearance between the quarter window assembly and the quarter window glass run retainer assembly, operate the window to its full down position, loosen the screw and washer assembly retaining the bottom of the run retainer, and adjust the retainer assembly forward. After adjustment, tighten the screw and washer assembly finger tight (Fig. 1).
To obtain proper clearance between the quarter window assembly and the quarter window glass run retainer assembly, operate the window to its full up position. Loosen screw and washer assemblies retaining the run retainer upper bracket and adjust the retainer assembly forward. After adjustment, tighten screw and washer assemblies D securely.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

Quarter Window Glass Adjustment — Fairlane and Montego — Models 63, 65 and 76
The following adjustments can be made without removing the trim panel:

Fig. 1 — Quarter Window Mechanism — Falcon — Model 62
Tumblehome (In-Out Tilt)
To adjust the tumblehome, loosen the lower guide plate retaining bolt at the bracket assembly (Fig. 2). Tilt the glass in or out until the proper glass-to-roof rail weatherstrip relationship is achieved. Tighten the guide plate bracket attaching bolt.
Belt Line In-Out and Fore-Aft Adjustment
The belt line in-out adjustment is controlled by two set screws located at the inside belt line (Fig. 2). Loosen the two screws and move the glass in or out until the quarter window glass is flush with the front door glass. Tighten the set screws.
Upper Front Stop Adjustment
Loosen the upper front stop attaching bolt. Move the glass until the correct up-down window travel is achieved. Tighten the stop retaining bolt
The following adjustments must be made with the trim panel removed:
Equalizer Adjustment
Loosen the bolt attaching the equalizer arm to the inner panel. Tilt the glass fore or aft until the top of the glass is parallel with the roof side rail. Tighten the equalizer bolt.
Upper Stop Adjustment (Complete)
Loosen both the upper front and upper rear stop attaching bolts. Move the glass until the proper up-down window travel is achieved. Tighten the stop attaching bolts.
Fore-Aft Adjustment
Loosen the lower guide plate attaching bolt at the bracket assembly (Fig. 2). Then, loosen the two upper guide plate attaching bolts. Move the glass fore or aft as required and tighten the three guide plate attaching bolts.
Quarter Window Glass Adjustment — Mustang and Cougar
The following adjustment may be made without removing the quarter trim panel:
Upper Front Stop
Loosen the two screws retaining the upper front stop at the top of the lock pillar (Fig. 3). Move the glass until the proper up-down travel is achieved, then tighten the stop retaining bolts.
If the above adjustment does not give a satisfactory window adjustment, remove the quarter trim panel and perform the following adjustments:
Tumblehome (In-Out Tilt)
Loosen the screw at the bottom of the guide plate which secures the guide bracket to the body (Fig. 3). Move the glass in or out until the glass seals against the roof rail weatherstrip. Tighten the retaining screw.
Belt Line In-Out and Fore-Aft Adjustment
Loosen the two screw and washer assemblies which retain the top of the guide plate. Move the window in or out until the quarter window is flush with the front door glass. Also, move the glass fore or aft as required. Then tighten the screw and washer assemblies.

Fig. 3 — Quarter Window Mechanism — Mustang and Cougar

Fig. 4 — Quarter Window Glass Mechanism Adjustment — Ford Model 62
Equalizer Adjustment
Loosen the screw and washer assembly at the lower guide plate bracket. Then, loosen the two screw and washer assemblies at the top of the guide plate. Tilt the glass fore or aft until the top of the glass is parallel with the roof rail weatherstrip. Tighten the screw and washer assemblies.
Upper Stop Adjustment
Loosen both the upper front stop and upper rear stop retaining bolts. Move the glass to the full up position. Move the stop firmly against the glass. Tighten the retaining screws.
Quarter Window Glass Adjustments — Ford Model 62


Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.


Lower the window to its full down position. Loosen the lower run retainer retaining screw (Fig. 4). Move the run retainer against the window and tighten the screw and washer A, finger-tight.

Fig. 5 — Quarter Window Adjustment — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 63


Raise the window to its full up position. Loosen the upper run retaining screw and washer assemblies (Fig. 4). Move the upper portion of the run retainer assembly against the window glass. Then, tighten the upper and lower run retaining screw and washer assemblies (Fig. 4).


With the top edge of the window flush with the belt line, loosen the lower stop retaining screw and washer assemblies (Fig. 4). Adjust the lower stop against the lower edge of the window channel. Then, tighten the lower stop retaining screw and washer assemblies


Cycle the window up and down several times to insure that proper adjustment has been made. Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.


Quarter Window Glass Adjustment — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 63

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Loosen items B, E, F, G, and P (Fig. 5).
Raise the glass to the up position to obtain a good seal with the roof rail weatherstrip.
Position the quarter glass forward or rearward to obtain a parallel fit between the quarter glass and the door glass. Then, tighten the screws (Items B and F, Fig. 5) securely.
Lower the glass to the full down position and tighten items E, G and P securely.
Check the window mechanism operation.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

Quarter Window Glass Adjustment — Lincoln Continental, Ford and Mercury Models 65 and 76
The following adjustments can be made without removing the trim panel:
Tumblehome (In-Out Tilt)
To adjust the in-out tilt at the top of the glass, use a 24-inch extension and socket and loosen the front run lower retaining bolt at the bottom of the run. Also, loosen the bolt at the bottom of the rear channel for additional tumblehome adjustment. This bolt cannot be reached without removing the trim panel. Move the run in or out until the proper roof rail weatherstrip-to-window glass relationship is achieved. Then, tighten the run retaining bolt (Fig. 6).
Belt Line In-Out Adjustment
Loosen the bolt retaining the front run at the top of the run. Move the glass in or out until the quarter window glass is flush with the front door glass. Tighten the upper run attaching bolt.
Upper Front Stop Adjustment
Loosen the upper front stop retaining bolt. Move the glass until the proper up-down window travel is achieved. Tighten the upper front stop attaching bolt.
The following adjustments must be made with the trim panel removed:
Equalizer Adjustment (Fore-Aft Tilt)
Loosen the equalizer attaching bolt. Tilt the glass fore or aft until the top edge of the glass is parallel with the roof rail. Tighten the equalizer bolt.
Upper Stop Adjustment (Complete)
Loosen both the upper front and upper rear stop attaching bolts. Move the glass until the proper up-down window travel is achieved. Tighten both stop attaching bolts.

Fig. 6 — Quarter Window Mechanism — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 65 and 76
Fore-Aft Adjustment
Loosen the two nuts attaching the regulator arm to the glass channel assembly (Fig. 6). Move the glass fore or aft as required and tighten the nuts.
Quarter Window Glass Adjustment — Continental Mark III

Remove the rear seat cushion and seat back from the vehicle.
Remove the quarter trim panel and cycle the window to the closed (forward) position.
Loosen the screw and washer assembly X (Fig. 7) and move the window fore or aft to obtain a 5/32 to 3/16 inch parallel gap between the quarter window and the door window.
Loosen the two nuts Y (Fig. 7) and move the window up and down as required for a proper fit to the roof rail weatherstrip and to obtain a parallel gap to the door window.
Turn the two set screws Z (Fig. 7) in or out to obtain a proper fit with the roof rail weatherstrip and the belt weatherstrip. Then, tighten the screw and washer (Item X) and the two nuts (Item Y) securely.
Install the quarter trim panel, seat back and seat cushion in the vehicle.

Quarter Window Glass Adjustment — Thunderbird
The following adjustments must be made with the trim panel removed:
Tumblehome (In-Out Tilt)
To adjust tumblehome, loosen the lower guide plate attaching bolt at the lower bracket. Tilt the top of glass in or out until the proper glass-to-roof rail weatherstrip relationship is achieved. Tighten the guide plate bracket lower attaching bolt.
Belt Line In-Out Adjustment
Loosen the nut from the set screw at the upper front corner of the guide plate (Fig. 8). Move the glass in or out until the quarter window glass is flush with the front door glass. Tighten the nut at the top of the guide plate.
Upper Stop Adjustment
Loosen the upper stops attaching bolts. Move the glass until the proper up-down window travel is achieved. Tighten both stop attaching bolts.
Equalizer and Fore-Aft Adjustment
Loosen the bolt at the upper rear corner of the guide plate, loosen the nut at the upper front corner of the guide plate and the bolt attaching the guide plate to the lower guide plate bracket (Fig. 8). Twist the guide plate assembly until the glass is parallel with the roof rail weatherstrip. Tighten the bolts. The fore and aft adjustment is made in the same manner except that the guide plate should be moved fore or aft to achieve proper window fit.

Fig. 7 — Quarter Window Installation — Continental Mark III

Fig. 8 — Quarter Window Mechanism — Thunderbird

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Removal and Installation
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-07
Quarter Window Glass — Fairlane and Montego — Models 63 and 65
Removal

Remove the trim panel and weathersheet.
Remove the upper rear stop (Fig. 9).
Remove the bolt at the upper rear corner of the guide plate.
Remove the lower stop bracket, and mark the location.
Support the glass and remove both the front and rear channel brackets from the glass channel assembly.
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the vehicle.

Installation

Position the glass and channel assembly in the guide plate assembly.
Install the lower stop bracket.
Install the upper stop.
Install the upper guide plate attaching bolt.
Adjust the glass as required.
Install the weathersheet and trim panel.

Quarter Window Glass — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 63
Removal


Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.


Support the glass and remove the glass channel bracket from the glass channel (Fig. 10).


Remove the equalizer arm bracket from the quarter inner panel.


Remove the lower stop and stop bumper from the quarter panel.


Remove the upper front and upper rear stops (Fig. 10).


Remove the front guide from the glass channel.


Disengage the glass and channel assembly from the rear guide and remove the glass and channel assembly.


Position the glass and channel assembly in the quarter and engage the channel roller with the rear guide. Engage the window regulator arm roller with the bracket on the glass channel.


Position the front guide to the front run and glass channel and install the attaching screws.


Install the upper front and upper rear stops and the lower stop and stop bumper (Fig. 10).


Position the equalizer arm bracket to the glass channel and the inner panel and install the attaching screws.


Position the glass channel bracket to the regulator arm roller and the glass channel and install the attaching screws.

Fig. 9 — Quarter Window Mechanism — Fairlane and Montego

Fig. 10 — Quarter Window Mechanism — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 63


Adjust the window mechanism as required.


Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.


Quarter Window Glass — Falcon and Ford — Model 62
Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove the two screws retaining the quarter window channel bracket to the lower window channel.
Roll the regulator assembly to its down position.
Tilt the window slightly in the window opening and remove the window assembly.
Remove the glass from the window channel, using a tool such as shown in Fig. 17, Part 42-02.

Installation

Install the glass in the lower channel, using new glass tape.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the window opening.
Install the channel bracket to the lower window channel and roll the window assembly up.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

Quarter Window Glass — Montego and Fairlane — Model 76
Removal

Remove the rear seat cushion and seat back.
Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove the upper stop and upper rear stop from the glass channel (Fig. 9).
Remove two screws attaching the glass channel front bracket to the glass channel and remove the glass channel bracket.
Remove the rear guide two upper attaching screws (Fig. 9).
Remove two screws attaching the front guide (Fig. 9) to the glass channel and remove the glass from the quarter panel.

Installation

Lubricate the front run, glass channel brackets, rear guide and window mechanism rollers (Part 42-01).
Position the glass and channel assembly in the quarter panel, inserting the glass channel roller in the rear guide and the regulator arm roller in the glass channel rear bracket.
Position the front guide on the front run and to the glass channel. Install the two front guide attaching screws.
Position the glass channel front bracket to the regulator arm roller and the glass channel. Install the two glass channel bracket attaching screws.
Install the upper stop and upper rear stop on the glass channel (Fig. 9)
Install the two rear guide upper attaching screws.
Adjust the quarter window as required.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.
Install the rear seat back and seat cushion.

Quarter Window Glass — Mustang and Cougar Models 65 and 76
Removal

Remove the rear seat cushion and seat back (Group 47).
Loosen the window guide bracket lower retaining nuts.
Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 47).
Lower the glass to the full down position, and disconnect the regulator arm from the glass channel.
Remove the upper front and upper rear stops (Fig. 3).
Loosen the window guide bracket upper retaining nuts.
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the vehicle.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as outlined in Section 1.
Install the glass and channel assembly in the quarter panel.
Connect the regulator arm to the glass channel (Fig. 3).
Install and adjust the glass upper stops and adjust the window guide bracket.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.
Install the rear seat back and seat cushion.

Quarter Window Glass — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 65 and 76
Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove the seal from the quarter pillar at the belt line (Fig. 11).
Remove two screws attaching the glass channel bracket to the glass channel and remove the bracket.
Remove the lower stop from the rear guide (Fig. 11).
Support the glass and channel assembly.
Remove the window regulator equalizer arm to inner panel attaching screw.
Remove the upper front and upper rear stops (Fig. 11).
Remove the front guide from the glass channel.
Disengage the glass channel from the regulator arm and the rear guide and remove the glass and channel assembly.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Section 1.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the quarter panel and engage the channel roller with the rear guide. Engage the window regulator arm roller with the bracket on the glass channel.
Position the front guide to the front run and the glass channel and install the attaching screws.
Install the upper front and upper rear stops.
Position the window regulator equalizer arm to the inner panel and install the attaching screw (Fig. 11).
Install the lower stop on the rear guide.
Install the glass channel bracket.
Adjust the window mechanism as outlined in Section 1.
Install the pillar seal, watershield, and quarter trim panel.

Quarter Window Glass — Continental Mark III
Removal


Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 47).


Pry the light from the roof quarter trim panel, and remove the roof quarter trim panel (Group 47).


Remove the headlining from the tacking strip at the window opening, and remove the tacking strip.

Fig. 11 — Quarter Window Glass Mechanism — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 65 and 76

Fig. 12 — Quarter Window Mechanism — Continental Mark III


Remove the two nut and washer assemblies (Fig. 7) from the lower adjusting screws.


Remove ten screws attaching the window regulator panel, and remove the panel (Fig. 7).


Loosen two screws attaching the quarter window assembly at the pillar.


Remove ten quarter window assembly attaching screws, disconnect the motor wires, and remove the assembly from the vehicle.


Remove six screws retaining the regulator housing inner panel to the outer panel, and separate the two panels.


Remove two nuts and washers from the adjusting screws that retain the glass and channel to the slide carrier (Fig. 12). Remove the glass and channel from the quarter window assembly.


Transfer the two adjusting screws to the new glass and channel assembly.


Installation

Position the glass and channel to the slide carrier and install the washer and nuts on the adjusting screws.
Position the inner panel on the quarter window outer panel, and install the six attaching screws.
Position the quarter window assembly in the vehicle and install the six retaining screws. Tighten the two screws at the pillar, and connect the motor wires.
Install the window regulator panel (Fig. 7).
Install the headlining tacking strip and attach the headlining to the strip.
Install the two nut and washer assemblies (Fig. 7) on the lower adjusting screws.
Adjust the quarter window.
Install the roof quarter trim panel and light.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

Quarter Window Glass — Thunderbird
Removal

Remove the trim panel and weathersheet.
Remove the belt line dust seal.
Remove both upper stop assemblies.
Remove the hairpin clip retaining the regulator arm to the glass channel assembly.
Remove the nut from the upper front and upper rear corners of the guide plate.
Remove the two bolts retaining the guide plate to the guide mounting bracket at the bottom of the guide plate.
Remove the glass assembly from the guide plate assembly and leave the guide plate in the body.

Installation

Position the glass assembly in the guide plate.
Install the nuts on the upper guide plate attaching bolts (Fig. 8).
Position the regulator arm to the glass and channel assembly and install the hairpin retainer.
Install both upper stops
Adjust the glass as required.
Install the weathersheet and trim panel.

Quarter Window Glass — Maverick
Removal

Pry off the latch bracket cover.
Remove the latch bracket retaining screws.
Peel back the weatherstrip to gain access to the window hinge retaining screws (Fig. 13). Remove the retaining screws and remove the glass from the vehicle.

Installation

Position the window glass in the window opening and install the glass hinge retaining screws.
Install the latch bracket retaining screws.
Install the latch cover.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Regulator -- Ford -- Model 62
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12
Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Prop the quarter window in the up position.
Remove two screws retaining the quarter window glass channel bracket and remove the channel.
Remove four bolts retaining the regulator to the quarter and remove the regulator from the quarter.

Installation


Position the regulator in the quarter and install the regulator retaining bolts.

Fig. 13 — Quarter Window Installation — Maverick


Position the quarter window glass channel bracket in the quarter and install the two retaining screws.


Remove the prop and install the quarter watershield and trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Regulator -- Falcon Model 62
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12a
Removal

Remove the rear seat cushion and back.
Remove the trim panel and position the watershield away from the access hole.
Disconnect the regulator from the glass channel rollers.
Raise the glass by hand and secure it in the raised position.
Remove the regulator retaining bolts, slide the regulator arm out of the equalizer and remove the regulator.

Installation

Position the regulator inside the quarter panel, engage the arm in the equalizer, and install the regulator retaining bolts snugly.
Position the rollers in the glass channel, lower the glass and connect the regulator.
Check the operation of the glass, adjust it if necessary, and tighten the retaining bolts.
Position the watershield, and install the trim panel.
Install the seat cushion and back.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Regulator -- Montego and Fairlane -- Models 63, 65, 76
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12b
Removal

Remove the rear seat cushion and seat back.
Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove four screws attaching the two glass channel brackets to the glass channel and remove the brackets
Remove the nut retaining the regulator arm to the inner panel.
Remove four window regulator attaching screws and remove the quarter window regulator.
Transfer the stud from the regulator arm to the new regulator if the regulator is to be replaced.

Installation


Lubricate the window regulator rollers and the glass channel brackets.

Fig. 14 — Motor and Drive Assembly Removal Precaution


Position the window regulator to the quarter panel inner panel and install the four attaching screws.


Insert the window regulator rollers in the two glass channel brackets and position the brackets to the glass channel. Then, install the channel bracket attaching screws.


Position the regulator arm and stud to the inner panel and install the retaining nut.


Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.


Install the rear seat back and seat cushion.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Regulator and/or Motor -- Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 63
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12c
Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove the equalizer arm bracket from the inner panel (Fig. 10)
Remove the front guide.
Support the glass and remove the glass channel brackets.
Disconnect the motor wires and motor support bracket if equipped with electric windows.
Remove the window regulator attaching screws; disengage the regulator arm roller from the glass channel; and remove the regulator from the quarter panel.
If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 14). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.
Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the window regulator to the quarter inner panel and the glass channel. Install the four regulator attaching screws.
Connect the motor wires and install the motor support bracket, if so equipped.
Install the glass channel bracket (Fig. 10).
Replace the front guide.
Install the equalizer arm bracket and adjust as required.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Regulator -- Mustang and Cougar Models 65 and 76
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12d
Removal

Remove the rear seat cushion and seat back (Group 47).
Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 18).
Lower the glass and disconnect the regulator arm from the glass channel (Fig. 3).
Raise the glass and support the glass in the up position.
Remove four window regulator attaching screws and remove the regulator through the lower opening.

Installation

Position the window regulator to the quarter inner panel and install the four attaching screws.
Lower the glass and connect the window regulator to the glass channel (Fig. 3).
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.
Install the rear seat back and seat cushion.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Regulator -- Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor Models 65 and 76
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12e
Removal

On convertibles raise the top partially. Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove the trim panel front retainer.
Remove the window regulator equalizer arm to inner panel attaching screw.
Lower the glass and remove the front guide. Then, remove the upper rear stop.
Support the glass and remove the glass channel bracket (Fig. 11).
Disconnect the motor wires and motor support bracket, if so equipped.
Remove the window regulator attaching screws; disengage the regulator arm roller from the glass channel.
Raise the glass partially and remove it from the rear guide. Remove the rear guide. Remove the regulator from the quarter panel.
If equipped with power windows, mount the regulator in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 14). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut through the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the window regulator to the quarter inner panel and the glass channel. Install the four regulator attaching screws.
Install the rear guide.
Connect the motor wires and install the motor support bracket, if so equipped.
Install the glass channel bracket.
Lower the glass partially and install the front guide. Then, install the upper rear stop.
Position the window regulator equalizer arm to the inner panel and install the attaching screw. Adjust as required.
Lower the top and lock in position on convertibles. Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Regulator and Motor -- Continental Mark III
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12f
Removal


Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield as outlined in Group


Pry the light from the roof quarter trim panel and remove the roof quarter trim panel (Group 47).


Remove the headlining from the tacking strip at the window opening.


Remove the headlining tacking strip.


Remove the two nut and washer assemblies (Fig. 7) from the lower adjusting screws.


Remove ten screws attaching the window regulator panel and remove the panel (Fig. 7).


Loosen two screws retaining the quarter window assembly at the pillar.


Remove ten quarter window assembly attaching screws, disconnect the motor wires, and remove the assembly from the vehicle.


Remove six screws retaining the outer panel to the quarter window inner panel, and separate the inner panel from the outer panel (Fig. 12).


Remove two stop attaching screws and remove the stop from the slide carrier (Fig. 12).


Remove the cable clamp from the regulator.


Separate the glass and carrier assembly from the regulator and motor.
Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and regulator plate (Fig. 14). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut through the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed from the regulator. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.


Installation

Lubricate the regulator assembly if necessary with polyethylene grease (C4AZ-19584-A).
Position the glass and slide carrier to the regulator channel (Fig. 12).
Install the stop and cable clamp.
Position the inner panel on the quarter window outer panel, and install the six attaching screws.
Position the quarter window assembly in the vehicle and install the six retaining screws. Tighten the two screws at the pillar, and connect the motor wires.
Install the window regulator panel (Fig. 7).
Install the headlining tacking strip and attach the headlining to the strip.
Install the two nut and washer assemblies (Fig. 7) on the lower adjusting screws.
Adjust the quarter window.
Install the roof quarter trim panel and light.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Glass Regulator -- Thunderbird
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-12g
Removal

Remove the trim panel and weathersheet.
If equipped with power windows, disconnect the motor wires.
Remove the window glass as previously described in this part.
Remove the bolts retaining the guide plate and remove the guide plate from the quarter.
Remove the hairpin clip retaining the regulator arm to the glass channel assembly.
Remove the four regulator retaining bolts (Fig. 8).
Support the glass and remove the regulator arm from the glass and remove the regulator out through the access hole in the bottom of the quarter.
If equipped with power windows, mount the regulator in a vise and remove the motor. If equipped with electric windows, mount the regulator assembly in a vise. Drill a 5/16 inch hole through the regulator sector gear and the regulator plate (Fig. 14). Install a 1/4 inch bolt and nut in the hole to prevent the sector gear from moving when the motor and drive assembly is removed. Remove the motor assembly from the regulator.

Installation

Position the regulator in the quarter, and install the four regulator retaining bolts.
If equipped with power windows, connect the motor wires.
Position the regulator arm to the glass and channel assembly and install the hairpin retainer.
Install the trim panel and weathersheet.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-14

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the quarter panel.
Lower the quarter window and pull out the run.
Position and install the run in the front retainer.
Install the watershield and trim panel to the quarter window.

Quarter Window Guide — Mustang and Cougar Models 65 and 76
Removal

Remove the rear seat cushion and seat back (Group 47).
Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 47).
Lower the glass and disconnect the regulator arm from the glass channel.
Remove the upper front and upper rear stops (Fig. 3) and remove the glass and channel assembly.
Remove four guide attaching screws.
Position the guide forward. Then, remove the glass and channel assembly from the vehicle. Remove the guide from the quarter (Fig. 3).

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as outlined in Part 42-01.
Position the guide in the quarter panel and install the four attaching screws finger tight.
Install the glass and channel assembly in the quarter panel.
Connect the regulator arm to the glass channel (Fig. 3).
Install the upper front and upper rear stops.
Adjust the window mechanism as outlined in Section 1.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.
Install the rear seat back and seat cushion.

Quarter Window Front Guide — Ford, Mercury and Meteor — Models 65 and 76

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove the guide retaining bolts and remove the guide through the lower access hole.
Position the guide to the quarter panel and install the retaining bolts.
Fasten the watershield and quarter trim panel in place.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Quarter Window Front Run -- Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor -- Models 65 and 76
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Quarter Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-05-14a

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield. Then, remove the dust cover.
Remove the upper and lower retaining bolts. Remove the run from the quarter panel.
Position the run in the quarter panel and install the retaining bolts loosely.
Adjust the run and tighten the bolts. Then, install the dust cover, watershield and trim panel to the quarter panel.

Quarter Window Rear Guide — Ford, Mercury and Meteor — Model 63
Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Lower the glass and remove the roof rail weatherstrip.
Remove the rear half of the weatherstrip retainer.
Remove the belt outside moulding and drip rail moulding.
Remove the upper front and rear stops. Then, remove the lock pillar seal.
Remove the equalizer arm bracket retaining screws and remove the equalizer (Fig. 10).
Remove the front guide from the glass and channel assembly. Then, remove the glass channel front bracket.
Raise the glass and remove the rear glass channel bracket from the glass.
Remove the glass from the vehicle.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the guide to the vehicle. Install the bolts but do not tighten them completely.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the rear guide and install the rear channel bracket (Fig. 10). Position the channel to the window regulator.
Position the equalizer arm bracket to the window regulator and install the retaining bolts snugly.
Lower the glass and install the glass channel front bracket.
Install the front guide. Then, install the stops.
Install the belt outside moulding and install the drip rail moulding.
Replace the roof rail weatherstrip retainer. Then, install the roof rail weatherstrip.
Install the lock pillar seal.
Install the watershield and the quarter trim panel.

Quarter Window Rear Guide — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 76
Removal

Remove the quarter window glass from the quarter panel.
Remove two screws attaching the rear guide to the outer panel at the belt line (Fig. 11).
Remove one screw attaching the rear guide to the guide lower bracket and remove the rear guide.
Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the rear guide in the quarter panel and install the attaching screws.
Install the quarter window glass and adjust the window mechanism as outlined in Section 1.

Quarter Window Rear Guide — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 65

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Remove the guide upper and lower retaining bolts.
Remove the guide from the vehicle.
Install the guide in the quarter panel, adjust as required, and tighten the bolts.
Install the watershield and the quarter trim panel.

Quarter Window Front Guide — Fairlane and Montego — Models 63, 65 and 76

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 47).
Remove two screws attaching the front guide to the glass channel. Disengage the front guide from the glass run and remove the guide.
Position the front guide to the glass run and the glass channel. Install the two front guide attaching screws.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:

Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield.
Lower the window and pull the run from the run retainers.

Installation

Lube the run at the front lower end with silicon and insert the run in the run retainers.
Raise the window and install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:

Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 47).
Remove the rear glass channel bracket from the glass channel.
Remove the nut retaining the window regulator equalizer arm to the inner panel.
Remove four screws attaching the window regulator to the inner panel and remove the regulator from the quarter panel.
Remove the upper stops from the glass channel (Fig. 9).
Remove the lower stop from the rear guide.
Remove two screws attaching the front guide to the glass channel and remove the guide.
Remove the lock pillar seal (Fig. 9).
Remove the front glass channel bracket from the glass channel.
Remove the belt line weatherstrips from the quarter panel.
Remove the quarter glass and channel assembly from the vehicle.
Remove two screws attaching the front run in the quarter panel and remove the run (Fig. 9).

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the front run in the quarter panel and install the two attaching screws
Position the glass and channel assembly in the quarter panel.
Install the belt line weatherstrip.
Position the front glass channel bracket to the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Position the front guide to the glass channel and install the two attaching screws.
Install the lower stop on the rear guide (Fig. 9).
Position the window regulator to the front glass channel bracket and the quarter panel and install the four attaching screws.
Position the window regulator equalizer arm to the quarter inner panel and install the retaining nut.
Position the rear glass channel bracket to the window regulator arm roller and the glass channel. Install the two bracket attaching screws.
Install the two upper stops on the glass channel (Fig. 9).
Install the lock pillar seal.
Adjust the quarter window mechanism as outlined in Section 1. Install the watershield and quarter trim panel (Group 47).

Quarter Window Front Guide — Fairlane and Montego — Models 63, 65 and 76

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 47).
Remove two screws attaching the front guide to the glass channel (Fig. 9). Disengage the front guide from the glass run and remove the guide.
Position the front guide to the glass run and the glass channel. Install the two front guide attaching screws.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

Quarter Window Rear Guide — Fairlane and Montego — Models 63, 65, and 76
Removal

Remove the quarter trim panel and watershield (Group 47).
Raise the glass all the way up and remove the rear guide top front attaching screw (Fig. 9).
Lower the glass and remove the rear guide top rear attaching screw.
Remove the rear guide lower attaching screw.
Raise the glass and disengage the rear guide from the glass channel roller. Remove the guide from the quarter panel.
Remove the lower stop from the rear guide.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism as shown in Part 42-01.
Position the lower stop to the rear guide and install the attaching screw.
Position the rear guide in the quarter panel and engage the glass channel roller in the rear guide.
Install the three rear guide attaching screws and adjust the window mechanism.
Install the watershield and quarter trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Vent Window Glass and Mechanisms · 42-06-04
Front Door Vent Window Assembly — Ford, Mercury and Meteor — Model 62
Refer to Fig. 10, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the rear run retainer bolt. Then, remove the bolt retaining the regulator shaft to the vent shaft.
Remove the bolt holding the front run retainer. Remove the screws retaining the vent window assembly to the front edge of the door.
Remove the remaining vent window assembly retaining screw, remove the assembly and remove the window glass front run.
Remove the front run retainer from the vent window. Then, remove the vent glass from the assembly.
Remove the upper pivot bracket and the two retaining screws at the top of the assembly. Then, remove the weatherstrip and division bar.

Installation

Install the division bar and attach the weatherstrip to the frame.
Install the retaining screws at the top of the division bar and install the upper pivot.
Install the vent window in the assembly and install the run retainer to the window assembly.
Position the vent window assembly in the door and install the retaining screws along the front edge of the door. Then, install the belt weatherstrip-to-vent window assembly screw.
Install the front run retainer to the door and install the front run. Then, install the rear run retainer.
Adjust the vent glass as necessary and tighten the retaining bolts.
Install the regulator shaft-to-vent shaft retaining bolt.
Install the watershield and door trim panel.

Front Door Vent Window Assembly — Ford, Mercury and Meteor — Models 54 and 71
Refer to Fig. 10, Part 42-02.
Removal

Remove the door trim panel and watershield.
Remove the vent window regulator.
Remove the front run retaining bolt.
Remove the window lower stop and lower the window.
Remove the three vent window assembly retaining screws and remove the vent window frame assembly from the door.
Remove the front run from its retainer.
Remove the run retainer from the vent frame.
Remove the rivet retaining the vent window pivot bracket and remove the vent window.
Remove the rubber weatherstrip from the vent window frame and pop out the four rivets.

Installation

Lubricate the weatherstrip with silicone lubricant, position the weatherstrip in the vent window frame and peen the retaining rivets.
Install the run retainer in the vent frame.
Install the front run in its retainer.
Position the vent window in the frame and install the pivot retaining rivet.
Position the vent window and run assembly in the door.
Install the retainer screws in the vent frame.
Install the lower run retainer retaining bolt.
Install and adjust the window lower stop.
Install the vent window regulator.
Install the door watershield and trim panel.

Vent Window, Division Bar, Frame, Glass and Weatherstrip — Falcon
Refer to Fig. 9, Part 42-02.
Removal


Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.


Remove the inner and outer belt weatherstrips.


Remove the glass lower stop and lower the glass all the way down.


Remove the vent window division bar lower adjusting screw and locknut.


Remove the front run and retainer from the vent window division bar.


Remove three screws attaching the vent window frame to the top leading edge of the door. Then, remove the vent window frame and division bar from the door.


Remove two screws retaining the vent window upper pivot to the vent window frame.


Remove the nut, spring, bushings, spacers and washers from the vent window lower pivot and remove the vent window from the vent frame.


Remove two screws and four rivets retaining the weatherstrip to the
GLASS AND CHANNEL REMOVAL TOOL (NO. 2900) AVAILABLE FROM SOMMER AND MALA GLASS MACHINE COMPANY, 5501 W. OGDEN AVENUE, CHICAGO 50, ILLINOIS frame and remove the weatherstrip.

Fig. 1 — Vent Glass Removal


Installation

Position the weatherstrip to the vent window frame and install the four rivets and two screws.
Position the vent glass in the frame and install the spacer, washer, spring, bushings and nut on the vent window lower pivot.
Install the two screws retaining the vent window upper pivot to the vent window frame. Then, adjust the lower pivot tension.
Position the vent window and division bar in the door and install the three attaching screws at the top leading edge of the door.
Insert the front run and retainer in the vent window division bar.
Position the front run to the window glass and install the vent window division bar lower adjusting screw and lock nut.
Raise the window glass and install the glass lower stop.
Adjust the front run and lower stop.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Vent Window Assembly — Fairlane and Montego
Removal
Refer to Figs. 1 and 8, Part 42-02.
If only the vent glass is to be replaced, use the tool shown in Fig. 1 to remove and install the glass in the frame. It is not necessary to remove the frame from the vehicle. If the frame, weatherstrip and/or division bar is to be replaced, proceed as follows:

Remove the trim panel and weathersheet.
Remove the bolt which retains the front run located at the bottom of the door.
Remove the vent window adjusting nut from the stud.
Remove the two bolts retaining the vent window assembly.
Remove the front dust seal from the door belt line notch.
Position the vent window assembly out of the way and remove the adjusting stud. Remove the window frame, division bar and run as an assembly.
Remove the screw at the top of the assembly and separate the run and retainer assembly from the frame assembly.
Remove the vent window pivot nut, spring, washer and nylon bushing from the pivot stud. Then, remove the pivot bracket, spacer and nylon bushing from the window frame.
Remove the glass assembly from the frame and weatherstrip assembly. Remove the screw at the top of the frame and remove the weatherstrip.

Installation

Position the weatherstrip to the frame assembly and install the retaining screw.
Position the glass assembly to the frame assembly.
Install the nylon bushing, spacer and lower pivot bracket and install the bracket to the frame.
Install the nylon bushing, washer, spring and nut on the pivot stud. Adjust the spring tension.
Install the run and division bar assembly to the frame and install the retaining screw.
Partially insert the vent window assembly into the door and install the window adjusting stud. Then, position the window all the way into the door and install the nut on the adjusting stud.
Install the two vent window attaching bolts.
Install the front run attaching bolt.
Adjust the window as required.
Install the dust seal, weathersheet and trim panel.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Tailgate Glass and Mechanism · 42-07-01
Tailgate Glass Adjustment
The tailgate glass is adjustable to obtain a watertight seal at the weatherstrip. To adjust the glass, loosen the two upper stops (Fig. 1). Then, loosen the glass run lower attaching screws (Fig. 1), and move the runs inboard or outboard to obtain a watertight seal between the glass and the weatherstrip. Tighten the run attaching screws and adjust the upper stops. To obtain a proper side-to-side adjustment, loosen the screw and washer assemblies retaining the glass channel brackets to the guides (Fig. 1). Move the glass as required and tighten the screws.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Tailgate Window Glass Emergency Lowering Procedure
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Tailgate Glass and Mechanism · 42-07-01a
If the tailgate window regulator mechanism should fail with the window in a partially closed or closed position, the following procedure should be used to lower the window.


Fig. 2 — Tailgate Emergency Opening — Typical

Remove the tailgate inside cover panel attaching screws.
Remove the two glass opening side garnish mouldings (Fig. 2).
Insert two wire hooks in the upper screw holes and slide the inner panel up and off the tailgate.
Remove the water shield from the tailgate.
Remove the four nuts and washers attaching the regulator arm brackets to the glass channel. Hold the glass and disengage the regulator arm brackets from the glass channel and regulator rollers. Then, carefully lower the glass into the tailgate.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.title: Removal and Installation
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-42-.content:
Tailgate Glass and Mechanism · 42-07-02
Tailgate Glass — Ford, Mercury and Meteor
Removal

Remove the tailgate inside cover and watershield.
Remove the right and left upper stops from the glass channel (Fig. 1).
Remove the right and left guides from the glass channel (Fig. 1).
Remove the right and left glass channel brackets from the glass channel
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the tailgate.

Installation

Lubricate the window mechanism (Part 42-01).
Position the glass and channel assembly in the tailgate.
Position the glass channel brackets to the regulator arm rollers and the glass channel, and install the retaining nuts.
Position the guides to the glass channel and runs. Insert the bushing in the right guide and install the guide attaching bolts (Fig. 1).
Install and adjust the right and left upper stops.
Install the watershield and the inside cover on the tailgate.

Tailgate Window Glass — Fairlane, Montego and Falcon
Removal

Open and temporarily support the tailgate.
Remove the tailgate cover panel retaining screws and remove the panel.
Remove the window regulator arm roller retaining pins, disconnect the arms from the rollers, and remove the rollers from the glass channel.
Remove the window from the tailgate.

Installation

With a glass remover tool, remove the glass lower retainer and channel, and weatherstrip.
Remove the weatherstrip from the glass lower retainer and channel assembly, and then clean the glass groove.
Position the weatherstrip into the glass lower channel. Install the weatherstrip and channel to the glass.
Slide the window assembly into the glass runs and connect the regulator arms and rollers to the glass lower channel.
Apply Lubriplate to the glass rollers.
Clean the old sealer from the tailgate cover panel and apply new sealer.
Install the tailgate cover panel to the tailgate.
Connect the tailgate hinge supports and remove the temporary support.

Tailgate Glass Run — Ford, Mercury and Meteor
Removal

Remove the tailgate inside cover and watershield.
Remove the right and left upper stops from the glass channel (Fig. 1).
Remove the right and left guides from the glass channel.
Remove the right and left glass channel brackets from the glass channel (Fig. 1).
Remove the glass and channel assembly from the tailgate.
Remove two screws and four nuts attaching the outside belt moulding and weatherstrip to the tailgate, and remove the moulding and weatherstrip.
Remove the run upper and lower attaching screws and remove the run from the tailgate (Fig. 1).

Installation

Position the run in the tailgate and install the two attaching screws.
Install the belt outside moulding and weatherstrip.
Position the glass and channel assembly in the tailgate.
Position the glass channel brackets to the regulator arm rollers and the glass channel, and install the retaining nuts.
Position the guides to the glass channel and runs. Insert the bushing in the right guide and install the guide attaching bolts (Fig. 1).
Install and adjust the right and left upper stops.
Install the watershield and the inside cover on the tailgate.

Tailgate Glass Regulator — Ford, Mercury and Meteor
Removal

Remove the tailgate glass.
Remove the glass channel brackets from the regulator arm rollers.
Disconnect the motor wires at the connector (if so equipped).
Remove four regulator attaching screws and remove the regulator from the tailgate (Fig. 1).
Remove the motor from the regulator and install the motor on the new regulator (if so equipped).

Installation

Position the regulator in the tailgate and install the attaching screws.
Connect the regulator motor wires at the connector (if so equipped).
Install the tailgate glass.

Tailgate Glass Regulator — Fairlane, Montego and Falcon
Removal

If the tailgate glass regulator mechanism should fail with the window in a partially closed or closed position, refer to the emergency procedure in this section.


Open and temporarily support the tailgate.
Disconnect the tailgate hinge supports at the tailgate.
Remove the tailgate cover panel retaining screws and remove the panel.
Remove the glass regulator arm roller retaining pins, disconnect the arms from the rollers, and remove the rollers from the glass channel.
Remove the window from the tailgate.
Disconnect the motor leads from the wiring harness in the tailgate (if so equipped).
Scribe the regulator mounting location, remove the regulator retaining bolts, and remove the regulator (with the motor attached, if so equipped).

Installation

In a power window, do not remove the electric regulator drive assembly for transfer to the new regulator until the regulator counterbalance spring is unloaded. To unload the regulator counterbalance spring, place the spring in a vise so that the spring cannot unwind, disconnect the spring from the outer retaining tab, and then slowly loosen the vise jaws.
Remove the screws retaining the regulator drive assembly and the motor to the regulator and remove the drive assembly and motor.
Position the drive assembly and motor to the new regulator and install the retaining screws.
Drill out the rivets retaining the manual clutch and housing assembly to the regulator. Remove and discard the manual drive assembly. The manual clutch and gear assembly should not be removed until the electric drive assembly is installed.
Install the regulator assembly on the tailgate and align the regulator as required.
Connect the wiring harness (if so equipped), to the motor and secure the harness in place with the retainer.
Install the window assembly into the tailgate.
Apply Lubriplate to the glass

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-43-.content:
General Doors, Hoods and Tailgate Service · 43-01-01
SILICON LUBRICANT COAZ-19553-A (JELLY) AND COAZ-19553-C (SPRAY)
This lubricant is to be used on the door window weatherstrips. It is recommended that silicon lubricant be applied to the upper weatherstrips at every regular lubrication period. Its use makes the doors easier to close, avoids weatherstrip squeaks, retards excess weatherstrip wear from chafing between the door glass upper frame and the weatherstrip. Also, it helps to retain door window alignment by reducing friction between the glass frame and the rubber weatherstrip.
Polyethylene Grease C4AZ-19584-B
This lubricant is used to lubricate door hinges. Apply an even coat to the hinge surfaces shown in Fig. 1.
Lock Lubricant B4A-19587-A
This lubricant is used to lubricate lock cylinders. Also, on Thunderbird and Continental Mark III models, this lubricant is used on the door hinges at the points indicated in Fig. 1.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-43-.content:
Doors · 43-02-01
Door Alignment
The door hinges provide sufficient adjustment latitude to correct most door misalignment conditions. The holes of the hinge and/or the hinge attaching points are enlarged or elongated to provide for hinge and door alignment (Figs. 1 through 3). Do not cover up a poor door alignment with a latch striker adjustment.
Alignment Procedure

See Figs. 1 through 3 to determine which hinge bolts must be loosened to move the door in the desired direction.
Remove the side cowl trim panel and/or door trim panel and hinge access covers (Figs. 1 through 3). Loosen the hinge bolts just enough to permit movement of the door with a padded pry bar.
Move the door the distance estimated to be necessary. Tighten the hinge bolts and check the door fit (Figs. 2 through 12, Part 44-01).
Repeat the operation until the desired fit is obtained, and check the striker plate alignment for proper door closing.

Door Open Indicator Switch Adjustment
The latch must be removed from the door to adjust the open door warning switch. Refer to Section 2 for the latch removal and installation procedure.

Fig. 1 — Front Door Hinge Installation — Thunderbird and Continental Mark III\


Loosen the switch attaching screw.


Set the door latch in the closed position.

Fig. 2 — Rear Door Hinge Installation — Thunderbird\


Position the switch contact near the latch cam (Fig. 4) but do not let it touch the cam. Then, tighten the switch attaching screw.


Set the door latch for the safety and open positions. The switch contact must make electrical contact with the cam when the latch is in the safety and open positions.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-43-.content:
Doors · 43-02-02
If a door latch system is inoperative and the door cannot be opened from either the inside or outside of the vehicle, fabricate a latch actuating tool as shown in Fig. 5. Use 1/8 inch welding rod or equivalent.


Lower the window glass of the inoperative door to the full down position.


Insert the latch actuating tool in the glass opening at the rear edge of the door and engage the latch pawl lever as shown in Fig. 6.


Apply a downward pressure on the latch pawl lever with the latch actuating tool. This will open the door. When the door is open, inspect the latch assembly and rod attaching points to determine the cause of the lock-out.

Fig. 3 — Front and Rear Door Hinge Installation — Ford, Mercury, Meteor, Mustang, Cougar, Maverick, Falcon, Fairlane, Montego and Lincoln Continental\

Doors · 43-02-05
Roof Side Rail Weatherstrip — Models 63 and 65

Remove the screw(s) attaching the weatherstrip to the body front pillar (Figs. 7 through 12).
On Mustang Model 65, remove one screw and three nuts retaining the weatherstrip at the quarter window beltline.
On Lincoln Continental Models, remove two screws retaining the weatherstrip at the quarter window beltline (Fig. 12).
Lower the quarter window and pull the weatherstrip from the retainer
Apply adhesive (COAZ-19552-A) to the weatherstrip retainer.
Install the weatherstrip in the retainer and press firmly into place.
Install the weatherstrip attaching screw at the body front pillar.
Install the screw and three retaining nuts at the quarter window beltline on Mustang Model 65.

Roof Rail Weatherstrip — Ford, Mercury and Meteor Model 57

Remove the screw from each end of the weatherstrip (Fig. 9).
Pull the weatherstrip from the weatherstrip retainer.
Apply adhesive (COAZ-19552-A) to the weatherstrip retainer.
Install the weatherstrip in the retainer and press firmly into place.
Install the retaining screws at each end of the weatherstrip.

Roof Rail Weatherstrip — Fairlane Model 66

Remove the screw retaining the weatherstrip to the body front pillar (Fig. 13).
Remove three screws retaining the weatherstrip at the lock pillar (Fig. 13).
Pull the weatherstrip from the retainer.
Apply adhesive (COAZ-19552-A) to the weatherstrip retainer (Fig. 13).
Install the weatherstrip in the retainer and press firmly into place.
Install the retaining screws at each end of the weatherstrip.

Roof Rail Front or Rear Weatherstrip — Thunderbird Model 57 and Lincoln Continental Model 53

Remove the retaining screw(s) from each end of the weatherstrip (Figs. 14 and 15).
Pull the weatherstrip from the retainer.
Apply adhesive (COAZ-19552-A) to the weatherstrip retainer as shown in Figs. 14 and 15.
Install the weatherstrip in the retainer and press firmly into place.
Install the retaining screws at each end of the weatherstrip.

A-Pillar Weatherstrip

Remove the screws from each end of the weatherstrip.
Pull the weatherstrip from the retainer.
Apply adhesive (COAZ-19552-A) to the weatherstrip retainer.
Install the weatherstrip in the retainer and press firmly into place.
Install the weatherstrip retaining screws.

Front Door Weatherstrip — Fairlane and Montego — Models 63, 65, 66 and 76

Remove five screws attaching the weatherstrip to the rear edge of the door at the belt line.
Remove one screw attaching the weatherstrip to the front edge of the
Disengage the weatherstrip retainers from the door and remove the weatherstrip.
Position the weatherstrip to the door and snap the retainers into place.
Install the five screws attaching the weatherstrip end to the rear edge of the door at the belt line.
Install one screw attaching the end of the weatherstrip to the front of the door.

Doors
Removal

Remove the trim panel, the water shield, and all usable outside mouldings and clips (if the door is to be replaced).
Remove the wiring harness and vacuum hoses from the door.
Remove all usable window and door latch components from the door (if the door is to be replaced).
Remove the hinge attaching bolts from the door and remove the door.
Remove the weatherstrip from the door.

Installation

Drill holes as necessary for attaching the outside mouldings. Install the door weatherstrips in proper position.
Position the door to the hinges and partially tighten the bolts. Then, align the door and tighten the bolts securely.
Install the wiring harness and vacuum hoses in the door, if so equipped.
Install the latch mechanism, the window mechanism, glass, and the glass weatherstripping. It may be necessary, at this time, to perform a final door alignment to obtain a satisfactory weatherseal at the windshield pillar and/or the roof rail.
Install the exterior trim, garnish mouldings, water shield, and interior trim.

Door Hinge — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury, Meteor, Mustang, Cougar, Falcon, Fairlane and Montego

Support the door.
Remove the hinge-to-body attaching bolts.
Remove the hinge-to-door attaching bolts and remove the hinge.
Position the hinge to the door and body, and install the attaching bolts.
Adjust the door as outlined in Section 3 and tighten the hinge attaching bolts.

Rear Door Hinge — Thunderbird


Remove the rear seat cushion and seat back from the vehicle.


Remove the quarter trim panel.


Mark the location of the hinge on the door and body.

Fig. 7 — Roof Rail Weatherstrip — Mustang and Cougar Model 65\

Fig. 9 — Roof Rail Weatherstrip — Ford, Mercury, Meteor Models 57, 63 and 65\

Fig. 10 — Roof Rail Weatherstrip — Fairlane and Montego Models 63, 65 and 76\

Remove four bolts attaching the hinge to the body (Fig. 2) and remove the hinge.


Installation

Position the hinge to the door and install the attaching bolts snug.
Install the four hinge-to-body attaching bolts snug (Fig. 2).
Adjust the door and hinges and remove the support.

Front Door Hinge — Thunderbird and Continental Mark III
Removal

Position a support under the door.
Remove the filler panels at the pillar around the hinge to be replaced.
Mark the location of the hinge on the door and body.
Remove three hinge-to-door at- taching bolts (Fig. 1).
Remove four hinge-to-body attaching bolts and remove the hinge from the vehicle.

Installation


Position the hinge to the body and install the four attaching bolts snug but not tight.


Install the three hinge-to-door attaching bolts snug.


Adjust the door and hinges and remove the support.

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-43-.content:
Door Latches and Locks · 43-03-01
Door Latch Striker Adjustment
The striker pin can be adjusted laterally and vertically as well as fore and aft. The latch striker should not be adjusted to correct door sag. The latch striker should be shimmed to get the clearance shown in Fig. 1 between the striker and the latch. To check this clearance, clean the latch jaws and the striker area, and then apply a thin layer of dark grease to the striker. As the door is closed and opened, a measureable pattern will result. Move the striker assembly laterally to provide a flush fit at the door and pillar or quarter panel.
Front Door Latch Actuating Rod Adjustment


Remove the door trim panel and watershield.


Disconnect the latch actuating rod from the latch actuating rod lever (Fig. 2).


Adjust the length of the rod, as required, to obtain the dimension shown in Fig. 2 at point A.


Insert the latch actuating rod in the latch actuating rod lever and retain in place with the clip.


Check the operation of the door outside handle push button and the latch assembly.


Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Fig. 1 — Door Latch Striker Adjustment\

Fig. 2 — Front Door Latch Actuating Rod Adjustment\

body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-43-.title: Removal and Installation
body/1970-ford-car-shop-manual-group-43-.content:
Door Latches and Locks · 43-03-07
Front Door Latch — Mustang and Cougar
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Disconnect the four rods from the latch assembly (Fig. 3).
Remove three latch attaching screws and remove the latch.
Remove the rod retaining clips and open door warning switch from the latch.

Installation

Install the rod retaining clips and the open door warning switch on the latch. Adjust the switch as outlined in Section 3.
Position the latch in the door and install the three attaching screws.
Connect the four rods to the latch assembly. Adjust the latch actuating rod, if required.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Latch — Fairlane, Falcon, and Montego — Models 54, 62, and 71
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Mark the location of the rear run lower retaining bolt. Then, remove the bolt.
Disconnect the four rods from the latch assembly (Fig. 3).
Remove the latch assembly attaching screws; disconnect the door ajar switch wire; and remove the latch from the door.
Remove the door ajar switch and rod retaining clips from the latch assembly.

Installation

Position the door ajar switch to the latch and, install the attaching screw. Adjust the switch.
Install the rod retaining clips in the new latch assembly.
Position the latch in the door and connect the wire to the door ajar switch. Then, install the latch attaching screws.
Install the rear run lower attaching bolt. Locate the bolt in the original position and tighten the bolt.
Connect the four rods to the latch assembly and check the operation of the latch. Adjust the latch actuating rod, if required.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Latch — Fairlane and Montego Models 57, 63, 65, 66, and 76


Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.


Remove the clip retaining the push button rod to the latch and disconnect the rod from the latch.

Fig. 3 — Door Handle and Latch Installation — Typical\

Fig. 4 — Front Door Latch Installation Ford, Mercury and Meteor\

Fig. 5 — Front Door Latch — Thunderbird and Continental Mark III\


Disconnect the remote control link, lock cylinder rod, and latch actuating rod from the latch assembly (Fig. 3).


Disconnect the wire from the open door warning switch.


Remove three latch assembly attaching screws and remove the latch from the door.


Remove the bushings, rod clips, and the open door warning switch from the latch.


Installation

Install the bushings, rod clips, and open door warning switch on the latch. Adjust the switch.

Position the latch assembly in the door and install the retaining screws.


Connect the remote control link and lock cylinder rod to the latch assembly.
Adjust the latch actuating rod and connect the rod to the latch.
Connect the push button rod to the latch. Check the operation of the latch assembly.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Latch — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor


Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door inner panel.


Models 54, 62 and 71: Remove the rear run lower retaining screw.


Disconnect the lock push button rod from the latch assembly (Fig. 4).


Disconnect the remote control link assembly from the door latch (Fig. 4).


Disconnect the outside handle actuating rod and lock cylinder actuating rod from the latch (Fig. 4).


Disconnect the wire from the door ajar warning light switch on the latch.


Remove three latch attaching screws and remove the latch from the door.


Remove the four nylon bushings and actuating rod clips from the latch assembly.


Remove the door ajar warning light switch from the door latch.

Fig. 6 — Door Inside Handle and Remote Control\


Installation

Position the door ajar warning light switch to the latch and install the attaching screw. Adjust the switch.
Install the four nylon bushings and rod clips in the latch assembly.
Position the latch assembly in the door and install the three attaching screws.
Connect the outside handle actuating rod to the latch and adjust if necessary.
Connect the lock cylinder actuating rod, remote control link and the lock push button rod to the latch assembly.
Connect the wire to the door ajar warning light switch and check the switch for proper operation.
Models 54, 62 and 71: Install the rear run lower retaining screw.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Front Door Latch — Thunderbird and Continental Mark III
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Disconnect the latch to remote control link and remove it from the door.
Disconnect the lock cylinder to latch rod from the latch (Fig. 5).
Disconnect the actuating rod from the latch assembly.
Disconnect the door ajar wire from the switch on the latch assembly.
Disconnect the push button rod (Fig. 5) from the latch assembly.
Remove the three latch attaching screws and remove the latch assembly from the door.
Remove the door ajar switch from the latch assembly.
Remove the four rod retainers from the latch assembly.

Installation

Install the door ajar switch on the latch assembly.
Install the four rod retainers on the latch assembly.
Position the latch assembly to the door and install the three attaching screws.
Connect the lock cylinder rod to the latch assembly.
Connect the push button rod (Fig. 5) to the latch assembly.
Connect the remote control link to the latch assembly.
Connect the actuating rod to the latch and adjust it if necessary.
Connect the door ajar wire to the switch and check the operation of the door and the door ajar switch.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Door Inside Handle and Remote Control
The door inside handle is attached to the door inner panel with two nuts. To remove the handle, remove the door trim panel and remove the two retaining nuts. Disengage the remote control link from the remote control (Fig. 6), remove the attaching screw, and remove the remote control from the door inner panel. When installing the remote control, be sure the seal is positioned between the door inner panel and the remote control (Fig. 6).
Rear Door Latch — Falcon, Fairlane and Montego
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Disconnect the remote control link and the lock control rod link from the latch assembly (Fig. 3).
Remove the three latch assembly attaching screws; disconnect the wire from the door ajar switch; and remove the latch assembly from the door.
Remove the two rod clips and door ajar switch from the latch assembly.

Installation

Install the two rod clips on the latch assembly.
Position the door ajar switch to the latch assembly and install the attaching screw. Adjust the switch.
Lubricate the latch assembly with Polyethylene Grease (C4AZ-19584-A).
Position the latch assembly in the door; connect the door ajar switch wire to the switch; and install the three latch assembly attaching screws.
Connect the remote control link and the lock control rod link to the latch assembly (Fig. 3).
Check the operation of the latch assembly and adjust the push button to specifications (Fig. 3), if necessary.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Rear Door Latch — Thunderbird

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Disconnect the remote control link from the latch assembly (Fig. 7).
Remove three door latch attaching screws and remove the latch and push button rod from the door.
Remove the push button rod and retainer and the remote control link retainer from the latch assembly.
Install the two retainers and the push button rod on the latch assembly
Position the latch and rod to the door and install the three attaching screws.
Connect the remote control link to the latch and check the operation of the latch assembly.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Rear Door Latch — Lincoln Continental, Ford, Mercury and Meteor

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.



Disconnect the remote control link and the lock control rod from the latch (Fig. 8).


Remove three screws attaching the latch assembly to the door.


Disconnect the wire from the door ajar switch and remove the latch from the door.


Remove the rod clips and door agar switch from the latch assembly.

Fig. 7 — Rear Door Latch — Thunderbird\

Fig. 8 — Rear Door Latch Installation\


Installation

Install the rod clips and door ajar switch on the latch assembly. Adjust the door ajar switch as outlined in Section 3.
Place the latch assembly in the door and connect the wire to the door ajar switch.
Position the latch assembly to the door and install the three attaching screws.
Connect the remote control link and lock control rod to the latch assembly (Fig. 8).
Check the operation of the latch assembly and adjust the rear door outside handle, if required.
Install the watershield and trim, panel on the door.

Rear Door Latch Bellcrank
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the lock control knob from the push button rod.
Remove one screw attaching the bellcrank to the door inner panel. Disconnect the lock control rod link from the bellcrank and remove the bellcrank from the door.
Remove the push button rod from the bellcrank.

Installation

Position the push button rod on the bellcrank.
Position the bellcrank to the door inner panel with the push button rod inserted through the hole at the belt line. Then, install the bellcrank attaching screw.
Connect the lock control rod link to the bellcrank.
Install the lock control knob on the push button rod and check the operation of the bellcrank.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Door Lock Cylinder
The key code is stamped on the lock cylinder to assist in replacing lost keys.
When a lock cylinder is replaced, both door lock cylinders and the ignition lock cylinder should be replaced in a set. This will avoid carrying an extra key which will fit only one lock.

Remove the trim panel and position the water shield away from the access holes.
Disconnect the lock controlto-door lock cylinder rod at the lock cylinder arm.
Remove the door lock cylinder retainer and remove the lock cylinder from the door.
Transfer the lock cylinder arm to the new lock cylinder.
Position the lock cylinder in the door, and install the lock cylinder retainer.
Connect the lock control-to-door lock cylinder rod at the lock cylinder.
Carefully position the water shield to the inner panel and install the trim panel.

Front Door Outside Handle
Removal

Remove the trim panel and wat- ershield from the door.
Disconnect the latch actuating rod from the latch.
Remove the screw and/or nuts retaining the handle to the door.
Remove the handle, pads, and latch actuating rod from the door.
Remove the actuating rod, clip, push button and spring from the handle.

Installation

Install the spring, push button, clip, and rod on the handle.
Position the handle and pads to the door and install the retaining screw and/or nuts.
Adjust the latch actuating rod.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.

Rear Door Outside Handle
Removal

Remove the trim panel and watershield from the door.
Remove the screw and/or the nuts retaining the handle to the door.
Remove the handle and pads from the door.
Remove the push button assembly from the handle.

Installation

Install the push button assembly in the handle.
Position the handle and pads to the door and install the two retaining nuts.
Install the watershield and trim panel on the door.
